jobs.description:
Our client, an international e-commerce business with a strong footprint in the United States, is looking for a Marketplace Creative Strategist/AmazonGraphic Designer to produce high-quality, conversion-oriented visuals across Amazon and other e-commerce platforms. This is a full-time remote position focused on product visualization, listing design, and brand asset development to support ongoing growth and uphold a premium brand identity. If you enjoy crafting clean, modern, high-end visuals and understand how design directly influences conversion rates and customer perception, we'd be happy to connect.

About the company

The company is a fast-growing eCommerce business focused on creating high-quality consumer products for customers around the world. Built on a foundation of innovation, quality, and customer satisfaction, the company continues to expand across global marketplaces while maintaining a strong commitment to operational excellence and long-term brand growth.

The company values initiative, ownership, and collaboration, and is looking for team members who are excited to contribute to a dynamic and fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

Amazon & E-commerce Design

  • Develop high-converting Amazon listing images and A+ content.
  • Produce clear, value-driven visuals that effectively communicate product benefits.
  • Ensure all creative assets follow Amazon guidelines and best practices.

Product Visualization & 3D Work

  • Build and refine photorealistic product renders.
  • Create visuals that clearly demonstrate product features and functionality.
  • Use composition, layering, and layout techniques to enhance clarity and visual appeal.

Conversion-Oriented Design

  • Translate customer pain points into compelling visual solutions.
  • Strengthen listing clarity, trust, and perceived product value through design improvements.
  • Optimize creatives to improve engagement and conversion performance.

Brand & Marketing Assets

  • Maintain a consistent premium brand identity across all materials.
  • Design packaging, instruction manuals, inserts, and product labels.
  • Develop visual assets for advertising campaigns (Google, Meta) and social media platforms.
  • Produce short-form video content for Meta ads and Amazon listings, incorporating AI tools where appropriate to streamline workflows and improve creative output.
  • Support broader video editing and product presentation needs.

Tools & Skills Required

  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere or similar).
  • Experience working with AI-based tools to enhance and accelerate design workflows (e.g. Nanobanana, Seedance, etc.).
  • Familiarity with 3D modeling and rendering software.
  • Proven experience in Amazon listing design and A+ content creation.
  • Strong sense of layout, composition, and visual hierarchy.
  • Ability to create clean, modern, premium-quality visuals.
  • Understanding of e-commerce principles and conversion-driven design.

Success Indicators

  • Consistently high-quality visual output aligned with brand standards.
  • Clear communication of product value through design.
  • Measurable improvement in product listing performance after design updates.
  • Reliable and timely delivery across multiple product lines.

Ideal Candidate

  • Prior experience designing for Amazon or e-commerce brands.
  • Strong portfolio showcasing product-focused visuals and renders.
  • Up-to-date with modern design tools and AI solutions.
  • Self-driven, independent, and able to execute efficiently.

What We Offer

  • Work for a market-proven, fast-growing company.
  • Competitive salary.
  • Supportive and collaborative work environment.
  • Opportunity to make a meaningful impact on brand growth and business performance.
  • High level of autonomy and ownership in your role.
  • Fully remote work and flexible working hours.

TASQ is currently looking Lead and Senior Consultants for Power BI and Analytics.

The work shift runs from 5pm to 2am and is fully remote.

Our focus is on Azure technology, offering numerous exciting prospects to develop your expertise in Microsoft and Azure within a dedicated environment committed to technical excellence and delivering exceptional client satisfaction.

Partnership with Microsoft: Our close global collaboration with Microsoft ensures a consistent stream of innovative Azure projects and direct engagement with the teams developing the platforman advantage rarely available elsewhere.

  • Build Power BI solutions by importing data from diverse sources, creating reports, dashboards, and data elements using DAX and source queries

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, data science, or related fields, or equivalent professional experience
  • Over 5 years of experience with data and business intelligence solutions using Microsoft tools (SSRS, Power BI, PowerPivot, PerformancePoint) or other BI platforms (Business Objects, MicroStrategy, Qlik, SAP)
  • Proficiency in TSQL, data modeling, and reporting with Power BI or similar tools
  • Proven experience designing comprehensive Power BI reports with interactive features, drilldowns, and nested parameters
  • Expertise in creating dynamic measures with advanced DAX
  • Knowledge of data mashups and transformations using Power Query/M
  • Hands-on experience with Databricks for developing and streamlining data workflows
  • Ability to select appropriate visualizations and design interactive report interfaces
  • Skilled in gathering requirements and conducting focus groups to improve business processes

Professional Skills:

  • Team-oriented mindset with a proactive attitude
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills; adept at working with both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Enthusiasm for learning new technologies
  • Strong analytical problem-solving skills, leveraging technology to address business challenges
  • Capable of performing effectively in fast-paced environments

Preferred Additional Experience:

  • Managing Power BI tenants and workspaces for development, testing, and deployment
  • Creating custom visualizations and analytics using Python or R within Power BI
  • Advanced SQL skills, including query tuning

- Experience in data quality assessment

  • Deploying Power BI solutions on-premises via Power BI Report Server
  • Using Power BI Embedded for embedding reports
  • Implementing cloud-based Power BI solutions utilizing Microsoft Azure services such as Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake, and Azure SQL Database​

Effective use of Power BI relies on high-quality data. We are seeking experienced lead consultants with expertise in Power BI and data management. Candidates should possess advanced knowledge of Power BI and its data components, including PowerQuery/M, DAX, and dimensional modeling, along with basic report design skills. Familiarity with SQL Server (including data warehouse architecture, SSIS, SSRS) and DirectQuery is advantageous. Additionally, understanding Power BI licensing options and advising clients on optimal licensing solutions is essential. Experience with Databricks for developing and optimizing data pipelines and workflows is required. Strong communication skills are vital for collaborating with clients, their teams, and technical specialists such as database developers and software engineers. Candidates should demonstrate excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities, a solid grasp of both technical and business intelligence concepts, and a commitment to staying current with Power BI updates. If you are passionate about Power BI and data-driven solutions and excel in client interactions, you might be the right fit.

jobs.description:
Job Summary:
The Middle Market Underwriting and Sales Region Leader is accountable for developing and executing the underwriting and sales strategy for an assigned region to achieve profitable growth and targeted financial results. The role leads regional business development, underwriting execution, and portfolio management while partnering with Distribution, Product Management, Marketing, and Underwriting Operations to achieve territory objectives.

The Region Leader provides leadership and direction to the regional team, using market insight, portfolio analytics, and sound underwriting judgment to identify opportunities, address performance issues, and make effective business decisions. The role builds strong agency and broker relationships, drives consistent sales and underwriting practices, and promotes collaboration across field and virtual teams. The Region Leader is also responsible for coaching and developing team members, strengthening underwriting and business development capabilities, and building a high-performing team positioned for sustained success.

Job Responsibilities:
· Leads the Middle Market underwriting and sales organization for the region, establishing business priorities, monitoring performance, and ensuring execution of regional new business, renewal, pricing, and profitability objectives.

  • Leads underwriting managers and underwriting teams to achieve appropriate productivity, service, and portfolio results while maintaining sound underwriting discipline and effective partnership across Underwriting, Underwriting Practices, and Underwriting Operations.
  • Builds a strong culture of collaboration across field, home office, and virtual teams and models effective teamwork, communication, and shared accountability for results.
  • Ensures adherence to underwriting guidelines, authority, policies, procedures, regulatory requirements, and quality assurance standards, including timely implementation of corrective actions and QA recommendations.
  • Leads and develops other leaders, establishing clear expectations for performance, coaching, and accountability while strengthening the team's underwriting expertise and ability to manage larger and more complex accounts.
  • Uses portfolio analytics, market intelligence, and business judgment to identify trends, prioritize opportunities, address performance gaps, allocate resources, and support effective underwriting and business decisions.
  • Establishes and maintains a disciplined, objective process for granting and managing underwriting authority based on demonstrated technical capability, experience, judgment, and performance.
  • Supports significant new business and renewal opportunities through agency and broker engagement, sales presentations, account strategy, and negotiation of coverage, pricing, financial terms, and service solutions.
  • Monitors performance against regional financial and operating objectives, identifies emerging issues and opportunities, and develops action plans to improve new business production, retention, pricing, profitability, and overall portfolio performance.
  • Owns talent management for the region, including hiring and selection, succession planning, performance and compensation management, employee development, career coaching, workload management, and resolution of employee issues that may affect team effectiveness.
  • Manages regional expenses within established plans, monitors spending throughout the year, and provides forecasts and variance explanations as required.
  • Maintains a strong understanding of commercial insurance market conditions, competitor activity, industry trends, and jurisdictional developments through agency engagement, industry participation, and other sources, and translates those insights into regional underwriting and sales strategies.

Job Description

Join Us as a Clinical Trial Coordinator – Make an Impact at the Forefront of Innovation
We have successfully supported the top 50 pharmaceutical companies and more than 750 biotechs, spanning 2,700 clinical trials across 100+ countries in the last 5 years.

As part of our global team, you’ll have the opportunity to provide administrative and technical support to the Project Team. As a Clinical Trial Coord, you'll support audit readiness by ensuring files are reviewed according to the schedule detailed in the organization's SOP and department guidance document. You will provide administrative support for site activation activities and aid in the development of the critical path for site activation within assigned projects to support rapid site activations. Representing CRG personnel, you may utilize local knowledge, organization systems, external site lists, and sponsor directives to develop and review site lists that are suitable for the strategic needs of feasibility activities and to provide local input into the site tiering process. Additionally, you may act as a buddy during the onboarding phase and provide training to new staff as needed.

What You’ll Do:

  • According to the specific role (Central or Local), coordinates, oversees and completes functions on assigned trial(s) activities as detailed on the task matrix.
    •Performs department, Internal, Country and Investigator file reviews as assigned, and documents findings in appropriate system(s).
    •Ensures allocated tasks are performed on time, within budget and to a high-quality standard. Proactively communicates any risks to project leads.
    •Provides system support (i.e., Activate & eTMF) and ensures system databases are always current.
    •Performs administrative tasks on assigned trials, including, but not limited to, timely processing of documents sent to Client (e)TMF as assigned, performing (e)TMF reviews, distributing mass mailings and communications as needed, providing documents and reports to internal team members.
    •Analyzes and reconciles study metrics and findings reports. Assists with clarification and resolution of findings related to site documentation.
    •Assists with coordination, compilation and distribution of Investigator Site File (ISF) and Pharmacy binder materials and non-clinical study supplies to sites.
    •Assists with study-specific translation materials and translation QC upon request.
    •Maintains knowledge of and understands SOPs, client SOPs/directives, and current regulatory guidelines as applicable to services provided.
    •Where applicable, conducts on-site feasibility visits (Asia Pac only).
    •May support scheduling of client and/or internal meetings.
    •May review and track of local regulatory documents.
    •May provide system support (i.e., Activate & eTMF). May support RBM activities.
    •May support the maintenance of study specific documentation and systems, including, but not limited to, study team lists, tracking of project specific training requirements, system access management and tracking of project level activity plans in appropriate system(s).
    •Transmits documents to client and centralized IRB/IEC.
    •Maintains vendor trackers.
    •Supports start-up team in Regulatory submissions.
    •Works directly with sites to obtain documents related to site selection.
    •Assists the project team with the preparation of regulatory compliance review packages.
    •Provides support as needed to coordinate with internal departments, ensuring site start-up activities within the site activation critical path are aligned.
    •May complete the ‘Site Interest Plan’ in CTMS and collection and delivery of associated documents from investigators and site personnel.
    •Documents in real time all communication, attempts an follow up associated with site contact and survey responses.
    •Supports the review of survey data to ensure responses are logical, complete and reflective of the question asked.
    •Works in collaboration with teammates to achieve targeted deadlines for assigned projects. Communicate with the team and appropriate clinical personnel regarding site issues and risks.
    •Ensures an efficient, effective plan is in place for site contact and follow up. Ensure compliance with the plan and escalate concerns/non-compliance to management.
    •May act as the local expert regarding site capacity and experience. Work with key local personnel to gather knowledge base and recommend additional sites. Harness this knowledge base when performing local tiering of sites.
    •Liaises with Global Investigator Services to resolve investigator queries in real time and maintain ‘accounts and contact’ information.
    •Contributes to the development and roll-out of global strategic feasibility processes and best practices.
    •Trains new personnel in processes and systems.
    •Utilizes local knowledge to contribute to the identification and development of new sites.

    •High / Secondary school diploma or equivalent and relevant formal academic / vocational qualification.
    •Bachelor's degree preferred.
    •Previous experience that provides the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job (comparable to 0 to 1 year).
    In some cases an equivalency, consisting of a combination of appropriate education, training and/or directly related experience, will be considered sufficient for an individual to meet the requirements of the role.

jobs.excerpt: About AbridgeAbridge was founded in 2018 with the mission of powering deeper understanding in healthcare.
jobs.description:
About Abridge

Abridge was founded in 2018 with the mission of powering deeper understanding in healthcare. Our AI-powered platform was purpose-built for medical conversations, improving clinical documentation efficiencies while enabling clinicians to focus on what matters most—their patients.

Our enterprise-grade technology transforms patient-clinician conversations into structured clinical notes in real-time, with deep EMR integrations. Powered by Linked Evidence and our purpose-built, auditable AI, we are the only company that maps AI-generated summaries to ground truth, helping providers quickly trust and verify the output. As pioneers in generative AI for healthcare, we are setting the industry standards for the responsible deployment of AI across health systems.

We are a growing team of practicing MDs, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to empower people and make care make more sense. We have offices located in the Mission District in San Francisco, the SoHo neighborhood of New York, and East Liberty in Pittsburgh.

The Role
We are seeking a dynamic and experienced SeniorPhysician Executive to join our Solution Design organization. As a strategic partner within the commercial team, you will provide expert clinical insights, support the evaluation of Abridge’s ambient solutions, and act as the clinical voice and advocate during customer interactions. Leveraging your clinical background and technological expertise, you will bridge the gap between clinical practice and technology implementation, ensuring our solutions effectively address real-world challenges. This role will help articulate and translate the value of Abridge’s solutions clearly and effectively to senior clinical and executive leadership.

What You’ll Do

  • Clinical Expertise and Advocacy: Serve as a clinical resource supporting sales and partner success teams by demonstrating how Abridge’s ambient solutions enhance clinical workflows and patient outcomes.

  • Strategic Commercial Support: Partner closely with commercial teams during demos, customer presentations, and strategic engagements, providing clinical credibility and subject matter expertise to executive-level audiences.

  • Customer Engagement: Act as the "boots on the ground" voice of clinicians, engaging directly with prospective and current customers, including senior leadership, to articulate clinical value, address questions, and facilitate adoption.

  • Solution Feedback Loop: Regularly provide insights and feedback from prospect interactions to the product and engineering teams, assisting in prioritizing product enhancements to align with clinical needs.

  • Thought Leadership: Represent Abridge at industry conferences, webinars, and events as a clinical thought leader, enhancing Abridge’s credibility within the healthcare community.

  • Product Expertise and Collaboration: Serve as the product expert for the commercial team, collaborating closely with the Product team to ensure alignment between customer needs, solution capabilities, and product roadmap.

What You’ll Bring

  • Clinical Experience: Significant experience as an MD, PA, or NP

  • Technology Integration: Proven track record working in healthcare technology roles (e.g., Clinical Informatics, Enterprise Analytics, Implementation Executive), demonstrating successful adoption and integration of clinical solutions.

  • Communication Skills: Exceptional ability to clearly communicate complex clinical and technical concepts to diverse stakeholders, including frontline clinicians, healthcare executives, and technical teams.

  • Executive Presence: Demonstrated experience and comfort engaging and influencing senior executives, including CNOs, CNIOs, CMIOs, CIOs, and CFOs.

  • Collaboration and Leadership: Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally, influence without direct authority, and serve as a trusted clinical advisor internally and externally.

  • Analytical and Strategic Thinking: Ability to evaluate clinical workflows, identify opportunities for improvement, and translate clinical requirements into technological solutions.

Bonus Points If...

  • Experience in clinical success, implementation leadership, clinical analytics, or similar roles within major health systems or healthcare technology companies (e.g., Epic).

  • Proven ability to manage and lead teams or complex projects, ideally with experience in healthcare quality, analytics, and informatics initiatives.

***This role requires 30-50% travel***

Why Work at Abridge?

At Abridge, we’re transforming healthcare delivery experiences with generative AI, enabling clinicians and patients to connect in deeper, more meaningful ways. Our mission is clear: to power deeper understanding in healthcare. We’re driving real, lasting change, with millions of medical conversations processed each month.

Joining Abridge means stepping into a fast-paced, high-growth startup where your contributions truly make a difference. Our culture requires extreme ownership—every employee has the ability to (and is expected to) make an impact on our customers and our business.

Beyond individual impact, you will have the opportunity to work alongside a team of curious, high-achieving people in a supportive environment where success is shared, growth is constant, and feedback fuels progress. At Abridge, it’s not just what we do—it’s how we do it. Every decision is rooted in empathy, always prioritizing the needs of clinicians and patients.

We’re committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally. Whether it's flexible work hours, an inclusive culture, or ongoing learning opportunities, we are here to help you thrive and do the best work of your life.

If you are ready to make a meaningful impact alongside passionate people who care deeply about what they do, Abridge is the place for you.

How we take care of Abridgers:

  • Generous Time Off: 14 paid holidays, flexible PTO for salaried employees, and accrued time off for hourly employees

  • Comprehensive Health Plans: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage for all full-time employees and their families.

  • Generous HSA Contribution: If you choose a High Deductible Health Plan, Abridge makes monthly contributions to your HSA.

  • Paid Parental Leave: Generous paid parental leave for all full-time employees.

  • Family Forming Benefits: Resources and financial support to help you build your family.

  • 401(k) Matching: Contribution matching to help invest in your future.

  • Personal Device Allowance: Tax free funds for personal device usage.

  • Pre-tax Benefits: Access to Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Commuter Benefits.

  • Lifestyle Wallet: Monthly contributions for fitness, professional development, coworking, and more.

  • Mental Health Support: Dedicated access to therapy and coaching to help you reach your goals.

  • Sabbatical Leave: Paid Sabbatical Leave after 5 years of employment.

  • Compensation and Equity: Competitive compensation and equity grants for full time employees.

  • ... and much more!

Equal Opportunity Employer

Abridge is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability.

We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the interview process. Once you submit your application, we'll follow up with details on how to request an accommodation for interviewing, completing any assessments, or otherwise participating in the selection process.

Staying safe - Protect yourself from recruitment fraud

We are aware of individuals and entities fraudulently representing themselves as Abridge recruiters and/or hiring managers. Abridge will never ask for financial information or payment, or for personal information such as bank account number or social security number during the job application or interview process. Any emails from the Abridge recruiting team will come from an @abridge.com email address. You can learn more about how to protect yourself from these types of fraud by referring to this article. jobs.excerpt: OverviewPaige Renewable Energy, a GCG company, is seeking an experienced Electrical Design Estimator to join our growing Paige Energy team and support utility-scale renewable energy projects across North America!
jobs.description:
Overview

Paige Renewable Energy, a GCG company, is seeking an experienced Electrical Design Estimator to join our growing Paige Energy team and support utility-scale renewable energy projects across North America!

As our Electrical Estimator, you’ll translate customer drawings, specifications, bills of material, and project requirements into accurate, executable estimates. You’ll perform detailed material takeoffs, develop project pricing, identify scope or design issues, and work closely with Sales, Engineering, Project Management, Supply Chain, and manufacturing partners to help ensure projects are positioned for successful execution.

This is a strong opportunity for someone who combines practical electrical knowledge with exceptional attention to detail and ownership. You should be comfortable working through large, complex project packages, asking thoughtful technical questions, challenging assumptions when something does not look right, and taking responsibility for the accuracy and completeness of your work.

While this role offers a remote work environment, we are seeking candidates in either the Eastern or Central Time Zone to align with the work schedule of the existing team.

What You’ll Do

  • Review RFQ packages, electrical drawings, site layouts, single-line diagrams, specifications, bills of material, and related documentation to understand project scope and requirements.

  • Perform detailed electrical material takeoffs, including cable lengths, harness and string counts, connectors, assemblies, accessories, and other project-specific materials.

  • Develop project estimates incorporating material costs, vendor pricing, freight, manufacturing costs, customer requirements, and other project-specific considerations.

  • Identify drawing discrepancies, missing information, scope gaps, incompatible materials, and other potential risks while clearly documenting assumptions, exclusions, and required clarifications.

  • Validate critical quantities, material selections, calculations, and drawing revisions before estimates are released.

  • Coordinate with Supply Chain and manufacturing partners to obtain and validate supplier pricing, lead times, freight requirements, and other cost inputs.

  • Support proposal development, design revisions, value-engineering opportunities, Best and Final Offer (BAFO) activities, and estimate revisions throughout the sales process.

  • Evaluate changes between estimate revisions and clearly communicate impacts to quantities, scope, cost, materials, and project requirements.

  • Maintain organized, traceable estimating files and supporting documentation that allow estimates to be independently reviewed.

  • Participate in project award and handoff activities, confirming that final estimates, quantities, assumptions, pricing, and scope align with the awarded project and customer purchase order.

  • Support estimating needs related to project changes, additional material requests, spare parts, and change orders.

  • Help improve estimating templates, tools, checklists, standards, and review processes by incorporating lessons learned from awarded and completed projects.

What You’ll Bring

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of electrical estimating experience, or equivalent electrical construction or design experience that includes estimating and material takeoff responsibilities.

  • Demonstrated ability to read and interpret electrical drawings, single-line diagrams, site plans, specifications, and bills of material.

  • Experience performing detailed material takeoffs and developing project estimates.

  • Strong understanding of electrical materials, cable, conductors, connectors, and electrical distribution systems.

  • Strong mathematical and analytical skills with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and experience using Bluebeam or similar takeoff and document-review software.

  • Strong organizational, communication, and collaboration skills with the ability to manage multiple complex estimates at different stages of development.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with renewable energy, utility-scale solar, EPC organizations, electrical contracting, or industrial electrical projects.

  • Proficiency with AutoCAD.

  • Working knowledge of the National Electrical Code (NEC).

  • Education in Electrical Engineering, Electrical Technology, Construction Management, or a related technical discipline; equivalent relevant industry experience will also be considered.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means producing estimates that are accurate, complete, timely, and traceable.

You’ll take ownership of your work, identify inconsistencies and risks before they become costly problems, clearly communicate assumptions and technical concerns, and help projects transition smoothly from opportunity through award and execution. You’ll also contribute to improving the tools and processes the Paige Energy team uses to make estimating increasingly efficient and reliable.

What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary ranging from $80,000 to $90,000 plus annual bonus based on company and individual performance

  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Multiple medical plan options (CDHP and PPO) to get you the coverage you need
  • Robust Financial Security: Company-paid life and disability insurance, 401(k) with company match, plus options for supplemental critical illness, accident, and hospital indemnity plans
  • Generous Time Off: PTO plan with paid holidays, paid parental leave, and paid compassionate care leave to support personal well-being and family needs
  • Wellness & Support Programs: Employee Assistance Program (EAP), wellness incentives, and telehealth access
  • Extras That Matter: Dental and vision plans, FSAs/HSAs with company contributions, pet insurance, legal services, and ID theft protection for peace of mind
  • An employee-centric company that values and truly appreciates our most important asset: You!

About Paige

Paige, a GCG company, has been delivering innovative wire and cable solutions for over 65 years. Serving industries including renewable energy, data communications, industrial applications, irrigation, and more, we are committed to engineering excellence, customer-driven innovation, and high-quality products that help businesses solve complex challenges with tailored solutions.

Built on a foundation of expertise, flexibility, and humility, we are dedicated to solving customer challenges, adapting to their needs, and continuously improving. At Paige, we remove ego from the equation, fostering a collaborative, customer-focused culture that drives long-term growth, innovation, and enduring partnerships.

Join us and be part of a company shaping the future of connectivity.

About GCG

At GCG, our mission is to power, connect, and automate our world. With the responsive DNA of a startup and the size of a global leader, we offer top brands and extensive value-added services that make us an invaluable partner to our customers in multiple industry verticals across the globe.

We are committed to meeting the needs of our customers, while focusing attention on our responsibility to the environment, our associates and the communities we serve.

This is a true ground-floor seat for the right CRO who wants to win together and build something great with us.

Partnership structure (LLC member with profit distributions)

This is a partnership role, not an employment role. You join as an LLC member with a defined membership interest. Cross-division CRO membership lives either at the holding-co level or pro-rata across division LLCs, negotiable based on revenue allocation.

The membership interest tiers are the headline. Tier 3 (3-8%) grants at hire if you clear a 6-month trial against the 5-gate evaluation. Tier 4 (8-15%, true partner level) progresses at month 18-24 with sustained firm-wide revenue performance. Vesting runs four years with a one-year cliff. Zero institutional debt means no forced dilution from future investor rounds, so your membership stays your membership.

Profit distributions flow quarterly, proportional to membership. Direct attribution adds 3-5% override on total firm revenue and 5-10% on revenue you directly sourced. Bonus stack: $25,000 at first $1M ARR milestone, $50,000 at $2.5M ARR, $100,000 at $5M ARR.

Guaranteed monthly distributions are the honest read on cash. We're a startup. Day 1-90 is $0 while you ramp on revenue attribution + membership vesting. Months 3-4, $3,000-$5,000/month activates once first division-wide revenue uplift is measurable. Months 6-12, $5,000-$10,000/month at $750K+ firm-wide attributable revenue. Year 1 OTE at target performance: $100,000-$250,000 cash + membership vesting.

The Supply Chain Management Technical Advisor II will provide technical support, accompaniment, and training to EMPOWER partners in South America to strengthen supply chain and operational preparedness for rapid emergency response.

The Supply Chain Management Technical Advisor II will work with EMPOWER partners to improve their supply chain preparedness and response capacities so that can set up and operate multiple modality supply chains (in kind and CVA) in an expedited manner.

This includes the following five priority focuses:

1) Updated specifications--Adjusting relief item/kit specifications and CVA transfer amounts to match latest technical recommendations, that are appropriate to the context, and which are available/possible in the local market;

2) Strategic sourcing--Exploring local markets to identify best output value suppliers (quality, delivery and price) for key relief items/kits and cash voucher assistance modalities (via financial and mobile service providers);

3) Prepositioned stocks--Establishing prepositioned stocks of key relief items in countries where it is hard to find them locally to the desired specifications (i.e. stored value cards, vouchers, humanitarian grade tarps, light and charge solar lanterns, and water purification tablets/satchels);

4) Open contracts--Setting up indefinite quantity contracts (open contracts/framework agreements) with best suppliers identified for key relief items/kits and CVA modalities; and

5) Continuous improvement—Supporting partners to identify ways they can improve their procurement, inventory management, logistics and distribution processes, tools and capabilities so they can enhance efficiency and responsiveness.

The role will work closely with partners and relevant CRS teams to identify and close priority bottlenecks, test readiness systems, and enable partners to procure, contract, transport, store, and distribute assistance quickly, responsibly, and in compliance with applicable standards.

Roles and Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the multiple modality supply chain set up process in all five target countries in close coordination with partner supply chain teams focusing on the whole supply chain from procurement to inventory management, and then planning for logistics and distributions when responses activated.
  • Make sure that all five priority focuses are executed as intended: updated specifications, strategic sourcing, prepositioned stocks, open contracts, and continuous improvement.
  • Support programming team with market and logistics analysis, hotspot prioritization, stakeholder mapping, and development of a workplan and deliverable calendar.
  • Work with technical leads and partners to establish minimum quality standards, packing guidance, replenishment requirements, quality-control processes, and substitution rules.
  • Validate priority kit contents against local market availability, cultural appropriateness, hazard scenarios, packaging needs, and branding and visibility expectations.
  • Collect and verify market prices and develop country-, hot spot-, remote-area- specific kit costing matrices that account for transport, handling, storage, customs or importation, last-mile delivery, supplier lead times, and other key cost drivers.
  • Map, assess, conduct due diligence on, and support prequalification of suppliers, transporters, warehouse providers, packaging providers, and other service providers, including backup suppliers and alternative sourcing options for key items.
  • Develop and maintain vendor databases and prequalified vendor lists organized by country, hotspot, sector, commodity group, and service type, with clear ownership, review frequency, renewal dates, and documentation requirements.
  • Support partners and relevant CRS functions to prepare or update open contracts, framework agreements, standby supplier agreements, emergency procurement templates, and associated contracting-readiness files.
  • Map and assess financial and mobile service providers for cash and voucher assistance, including geographic coverage, transfer modalities, fees, liquidity, surge capacity, compliance, data protection, reporting capacity, and humanitarian experience.
  • Support financial and mobile service provider contracting readiness and partner protocols for activation, secure data transfer, reconciliation, complaints handling, and failed-payment procedures.
  • Assess partner procurement, contracting, warehousing, inventory management, transport, distribution, documentation, segregation-of-duties, and quality-assurance processes; facilitate practical improvements to close priority gaps.
  • Provide guidance on warehouse requirements by inventory type, stock security, inventory systems, storage practices, and readiness for safe and orderly in-kind distributions, including relevant manuals and procedures.
  • Map regional land, sea, and air shipping routes and options for partners operating across multiple countries, including arrangements for inter-country movement of relief items where applicable.
  • Develop partner-specific readiness checklists and action plans with defined actions, responsible persons, deadlines, support needs, approvals, compliance risks, contingency arrangements, escalation points, and maintenance responsibilities.
  • Support partner to conduct supply chain constraint analysis and then develop continuous improvement plans to address the priority constraints.
  • Design and facilitate coaching, working sessions, simulations, or readiness tests so partner staff can apply and maintain the tools and procedures developed through the assignment.
  • Consolidate and hand over the final supply chain readiness package, including tools, databases, action plans, ownership arrangements, maintenance recommendations, and an exit debrief.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Strong technical knowledge of emergency procurement, sourcing, contracting, vendor management, transport, warehouse management, inventory control, quality assurance, distribution logistics, and supply chain risk management.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to translate assessments into realistic, prioritized actions and usable tools.
  • Ability to facilitate partner-led processes, build trust, adapt technical depth to partner needs, and support sustainable ownership of readiness systems.
  • Excellent planning, coordination, documentation, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams and deliverables across countries.
  • Strong interpersonal, negotiation, and professional communication skills, including the ability to work effectively with procurement, operations, finance, legal, grants, technical, and partner leadership teams.
  • Proactive, resourceful, solution-oriented, culturally sensitive, and results-focused.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, web-conferencing platforms, and common information-management systems.

Required Languages: Professional fluency in English and Spanish is required. Professional proficiency in Portuguese is strongly preferred; and French is an advantage for engagement across the target regions.

Travel: The assignment will be primarily remote, with in-country or regional travel to priority partners, countries, or hot spots as approved and operationally required. The selected candidate must be able and willing to travel within South America and work effectively across time zones and diverse operating environments.

Supervisory Responsibilities: Yes

jobs.description:
Engagement type: Independent consultant, 1099 hourly.
Rate range: $100 - $500 per hour, based on experience and scope (three-tier band detailed below).
Time commitment: Project-based, scales with proposal volume.
Location: Fully remote.
Reports to: GovCon Division Lead, with dotted line to the Federal Capture Director.

A note from the founder

A great proposal is the difference between a captured opportunity and an awarded contract. We have the capture motion ramping up. We need the operator who turns the captured opportunity into a compliant, compelling, on-time response, and who builds the response library so every future proposal moves faster than the last.

What is already built

The Wilkinson Firm is a workforce strategy and staffing firm headquartered across NC and Atlanta. We launched in April 2025 and are now in Year 2 of operations. Two operational divisions today (HR Advisory for the mental health industry, Premium Hospitality and Event Staffing). Government Contracting division being formally stood up this quarter. Three active staffing contracts in delivery. FY26 trajectory $425-525K. Zero loans, zero institutional debt.

Bench credentials: Former EEOC Administrative Law Judge, employment attorneys (JD, MBA), clinical advisors, 32-year enterprise operations specialist. 47 combined years HHS experience.

What you own

  • Full proposal lifecycle: kickoff, compliance matrix, schedule, color-team reviews (pink, red, gold), production, submission
  • Technical writing and editing across executive summary, technical approach, management approach, past performance, and resumes of key personnel
  • Compliance matrix ownership: every shall, every Section L and M requirement, every page count, every font and margin spec
  • Response library build: past performance citations, key personnel resumes, technical narratives, reusable management approach modules, pricing structures
  • Coordination with the Federal Capture Director on win themes, discriminators, and ghosting strategy
  • Coordination with subcontractor partners on teaming inputs and price submissions
  • Post-submission tracking, debrief capture, and lessons-learned documentation

Engagement structure

Hourly consulting rate, three tiers calibrated to experience and scope:

  • Writer ($100-175/hr): Proposal writers and coordinators with 3-7 years federal proposal experience
  • Manager ($175-325/hr): Proposal managers with documented win history and full-lifecycle ownership
  • Principal ($325-500/hr): Senior proposal directors with multi-million-dollar award history and Tier 1 prime experience

Engagement is hourly. Per-proposal scope and budget defined at proposal kickoff. Win-based bonus stack negotiable on top of hourly rate for proposals that result in awarded contracts.

Success milestones

  • First 60 days: Proposal process documented. Compliance matrix template built. Response library framework established with 5+ reusable past performance citations.
  • First 120 days: First 1-2 proposals submitted on time, compliant, and competitive. Color-team review cadence established.
  • First 180 days: 3-5 proposals submitted. First award or shortlist position. Response library covers 80% of TWF's standard content needs.

Who you are

  • 5-15 years in federal proposal management, technical writing, or capture support
  • Documented track record managing $1M+ federal proposals through full lifecycle to submission
  • Shipley-trained or equivalent. APMP credential preferred
  • Fluent in FAR/DFARS, RFP structure (Sections L and M), and compliance matrix methodology
  • Strong writing voice: clear, persuasive, and adaptable across technical and management content
  • Comfortable working both as lead writer and as orchestrator of subject matter expert input
  • Past performance citations in workforce services, HHS programs, hospitality contracting, or staffing IDIQs preferred
  • Located anywhere in the US

Bonus points

  • Prior role at a Tier 1 GovCon prime or boutique proposal shop
  • Experience with VA, HHS, DoD behavioral health, or federal hospitality contracts
  • Pricing strategy fluency (cost narrative, BOEs, indirect rate structures)
  • Experience standing up a proposal function inside an emerging GovCon firm

How we will get to know each other

  1. Initial 30-minute fit conversation with the GovCon Division Lead
  2. Working session: walk through a real proposal scenario we are actively considering or recently submitted
  3. Reference checks (3+ professional references) and work history verification
  4. Engagement letter, scope of work, and rate confirmation
  5. Kickoff within 7 days of signed engagement

What we believe

Trust before revenue. Mission before money. Real seats, real upside. We build durable federal relationships through earned credibility. We win together. We pay people in real numbers, not pizza parties.

Application tips

  1. Visit , ,
  2. Find The Wilkinson Firm on LinkedIn
  3. In your cover note, answer two questions: (1) what's the engagement shape that works best for you (project-based, retained hours, hybrid), and (2) one example of a federal proposal you would point to as your strongest reference work

What to expect from us

  • Reply within 48 hours
  • First-round conversation within 7 days of qualification
  • Full process: 2-4 weeks
  • We tell you yes or no. We do not ghost.

Invoice Processing Specialist

Job Type: Full-time
Work Setup: Remote
Schedule: Full-time; must have availability to overlap with U.S. Eastern Time (EST) business hours

Apply here:

About the Role

We are looking for a detail-oriented Invoice Processing Specialist to manage and verify invoices associated with medical records requests.

In this role, you will review incoming invoices, match them to the appropriate requests, verify amounts and payment requirements, process payments, and resolve discrepancies or disputes. The position requires strong numerical accuracy, attention to detail, and the ability to identify potential duplicate or fraudulent payment requests.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage the Invoice Queue: Review and process incoming invoices daily, prioritizing overdue items and time-sensitive requests.
  • Match and Verify Invoices: Confirm patient, provider, record type, invoice details, and payment amounts before processing.
  • Identify Duplicates: Review potential duplicate or near-match invoices and verify whether they represent legitimate charges before payment.
  • Apply Payment Limits and Requirements: Process payments within approved limits and route amounts exceeding authorized limits for the appropriate approval.
  • Review Fees: Identify potentially incorrect or disallowed fees and initiate the appropriate dispute or escalation process.
  • Process Payments: Make payments through credit card, online provider portals, prepayment systems, mailed checks, or other approved methods.
  • Resolve Payment Disputes: Follow up on duplicate charges, incorrect fees, refunds, or other payment issues and maintain clear documentation of each resolution.
  • Maintain Payment Records: Keep accurate records of invoices, payments, disputes, approvals, and related communications.
  • Verify Payment Information: Follow established procedures to verify changes to vendor payment details using trusted contact information before processing payments.
  • Follow Internal Procedures: Ensure all payments and invoice-processing activities follow established approval, documentation, and security procedures.

Required Qualifications

  • Strong numerical accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Excellent written English with the ability to create clear and concise notes.
  • Experience reviewing invoices, payment information, or financial records.
  • Strong ability to identify discrepancies and potential duplicates.
  • Good organizational and time-management skills.
  • Ability to work accurately in a high-volume environment.
  • Strong problem-solving and follow-up skills.
  • Ability to work independently and follow established procedures.
  • Ability to work a schedule that overlaps with U.S. Eastern Time business hours.

Skills Assessment

Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a timed skills assessment independently and without the use of AI tools.

The assessment may evaluate:

  • Duplicate invoice detection
  • Invoice-to-request matching
  • Accuracy when reviewing amounts, dates, and invoice information
  • Navigating online invoice and payment portals
  • Understanding payment approval requirements
  • Fraud awareness and payment verification
  • Handling payment disputes and refunds
  • Accuracy, judgment, and attention to detail

Preferred Experience

Experience in any of the following areas is an advantage:

  • Accounts payable
  • Invoice processing
  • Vendor payments
  • High-volume payment processing
  • Healthcare billing or revenue cycle operations
  • Payment reconciliation
  • Payment disputes and refunds
  • Excel or Google Sheets
  • Medical records or healthcare information processes
  • Experience using healthcare or records-related vendor portals

Key Skills

  • Invoice processing
  • Accounts payable
  • Payment verification
  • Data and numerical accuracy
  • Duplicate detection
  • Reconciliation
  • Payment dispute resolution
  • Fraud awareness
  • Spreadsheet management
  • Attention to detail
  • Organization and follow-through
  • Written communication

What We Offer

  • Full-time remote work
  • Opportunity to develop experience in invoice processing and healthcare-related operations
  • Opportunities for advancement into senior processing, finance operations, quality, or team leadership roles

Hourly consulting rate, three tiers calibrated to experience and scope:

Who you are

  • Shipley-trained or equivalent. APMP credential preferred
  • Fluent in FAR/DFARS, RFP structure (Sections L and M), and compliance matrix methodology

Trust before revenue. Mission before money. Real seats, real upside. We build durable federal relationships through earned credibility. We win together. We pay people in real numbers, not pizza parties.

TWF's Hospitality Staffing division has the founder, operational leadership, and three signed contracts in delivery. There is no dedicated outbound motion yet. You're it. Overview

Since our founding in 1924, we've cut cardiovascular disease deaths in half, but there is still so much more to do. To overcome today’s biggest health challenges and accelerate this progress, we need passionate individuals like you. Join our movement, be part of the progress, and help ensure a healthier future for all. You matter, and so does the impact you can make with us.

The American Heart Association (Association) has an excellent opportunity for a Senior Communications Manager - Science Media Relations.

This is a position that can be home-based and a flexible location.

The Association offers many resources to help you maintain work-life harmonization through your changing needs and life situations. To help you be successful, you will have access to Heart U, our award-winning corporate university, as well as additional training and support, locally.

#TheAHALife is more than a company culture; it is our way of life. It embodies our commitment to work-life harmonization and is guided by our core values where our employees can thrive both personally and professionally. Discover why you will Be Seen. Be Heard. Be Valued at the American Heart Association by following us on LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X, and at heart.jobs.

Responsibilities

In this role, you will be responsible for the implementation of multi-year strategic communication plans supporting and promoting scientific manuscripts published in the American Heart Association’s 14 peer-reviewed scientific and medical journals, abstracts presented at the Association’s scientific meetings and the Association’s clinical care guidelines, scientific statements and advisories to the media and the public. Responsible for developing appropriate resources and translating the science for the media and the public, to reinforce the Association’s role as a leading voice in cardiovascular and brain health science and care, and the Association’s mission and impact goals. Responsible for securing earned media coverage, establishing and cultivating relationships with journalists, and supporting our science leaders and research authors of scientific manuscripts and abstracts presenting at our scientific meetings or publishing in our scientific journals, and other projects as assigned.

Essential Job Duties:

  • Review manuscripts accepted for publication in our scientific journals and abstracts accepted for presentation at our scientific meetings.
  • Develop news releases or other news materials, media pitches, and multi-media assets to promote scientific research featured in abstracts and manuscripts, published in the American Heart Association’s 14 peer-reviewed scientific journals and/or presented at any of the Association’s 7 scientific meetings, or to promote the Association’s clinical care guidelines, scientific statements, and advisories.
  • Collaborate with team members to review and select abstracts to promote, provide peer edits for colleagues’ news releases, develop talking points, key messages for research authors and/or experts for commentary and perspective.
  • Lead development of news kits for one or more of our scientific meetings, which includes review and selection of abstracts for promotion; developing detailed news releases that include expert quotes/perspectives as well as research author perspectives,; producing or collaborating with other teams for all related news materials, which may include video interviews, talking points, key messages, FAQs and/or infographics.
  • Work with the Senior Director and the Vice President on the traditional and social media, as well as Association-owned channels.
  • Develop strategic communications plans, media opportunities and relationships to promote the Association’s role as a thought leader in cardiovascular science and brain health, including the Association’s clinical care guidelines, scientific statements and advisories.
  • Monitor the traditional media and social media landscape to ensure the Association can respond appropriately to breaking news related to heart and brain health and latest evidence-based recommendations to mitigate risk, as well efforts to protect the Association’s reputation and integrity.
  • Collaborate with internal teams, including Science and Medicine, Science Operations, Scientific Publishing, Science Marketing, Social Media Marketing, Health and Science Programs, and Enterprise-Wide Mobilization teams, and external collaborators to optimize communications reach and amplify the Association’s life-saving mission among volunteers, internal stakeholders, and external partners.
  • Supervise up to 2 members of the Science Media Relations team in close collaboration with the Senior Director.
  • Lead or support other Communications initiatives as applicable and relevant.
  • Mentor and coach Science Media Relations team members and internal and external collaborators.

Want to help get your resume to the top? Take a look at the experience we require:

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Communications or equivalent experience.
  • Five (5) years of excellent writing and editing skills, translating scientific research for the public, and solid knowledge of AP Style.
  • Five (5) years of managing the submission of press, promotional, or related content, building relationships with journalists, and securing quality earned media coverage.
  • Five (5) years of proficient computer skills, including all Microsoft Office programs, especially Word, PowerPoint, and Excel.
  • Five (5) years of project management experience, including managing multiple projects concurrently.
  • Five (5) years of demonstrated ability to work under tight deadlines, while facing competing demands and priorities for multiple projects.
  • Ability to travel up to 10%-15% local and overnight stay.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Eight (8) years of relevant experience.
  • At least three (3) years of experience in a successful supervisory role.
  • Proven ability to review and translate scientific abstracts and manuscripts; develop newsworthy ideas and approaches; write and pitch stories to media outlets; manage media interviews and produce news conferences, including prepping research authors and experts; craft talking points and/or key messages; foster collaborative relationships with reporters that position the organization as a primary resource for their stories.
  • Portfolio demonstrating successful expertise in developing and implementing multi-faceted media strategies that generate visibility for scientific publications, journals, and scientific meetings.

Compensation & Benefits

Salary minimum to the midpoint of the range is $86,000.00 to $102,000.00. Pay is commensurate with experience; geographic differentials may apply to the pay range. The American Heart Association reserves the right to pay more or less than the posted range.

The American Heart Association invests in its people. Here are the main components of our total rewards package. Visit Rewards & Benefits to see more details.

  • Compensation – Our goal is to ensure you have a competitive base salary. That’s why we regularly review the market value of jobs and make adjustments, as needed.
  • Performance and Recognition – You are rewarded for achieving success through annual salary planning and incentive programs; eligibility for an incentive program is based on the type of position.
  • Benefits – We offer a wide array of benefits including medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance, along with a robust retirement program that includes an employer match and automatic contribution. As a mark of our commitment to employee well-being, we also offer an employee assistance program, employee wellness program and telemedicine, and medical consultation.
  • Professional Development – You can join one of our many Employee Resource Groups (ERG) or be a mentor/mentee in our professional mentoring program. Heart U is the Association’s national online university, with more than 100,000 resources designed to meet your needs and busy schedule.
  • Work-Life Harmonization – The Association offers Paid Time Off (PTO) at a minimum of 16 days per year for new employees. The number of days will increase based on seniority level. You will also have a total of 12 paid holidays off each year, which includes several days off at the end of the year.
  • Tuition Assistance - We support the career development of all employees. This program provides financial assistance to employees who wish to further their education and career in relation to their current duties and responsibilities, or for potential future positions in the organization.

The American Heart Association’s 2028 Goal: Building on over 100 years of trusted leadership in cardiovascular and brain health, by 2028 the Association will drive breakthroughs and implement proven solutions in science, policy, and care for healthier people and communities. The greatest discoveries in health must reach everyone where they are.

Job Title: Customer Engagement Manager - Gris (Danmark)

Job Location: REMOTE, Denmark

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Job Description

Vær en aktiv medspiller forfremtidens griseproduktion i Danmark

Er du dyrlæge og motiveres af at kombinere faglig ekspertise, praktisk problemløsning i besætninger og tæt samarbejde med dyrlæger og griseproducenter? Har du lyst til at bidrage til udviklingen af en bæredygtig fremtid for dansk griseproduktion? Så er dette måske den mulighed, du leder efter.

I vores organisation arbejder vi ud fra visionen omScience of Healthier Animalsog en stærk tro på forebyggelse som fundamentet for både dyrevelfærd og produktivitet. Vores ambition er klar: Vi ønsker at levere løsninger, ikke blot produkter. Ved at kombinere videnskabelig indsigt, kommerciel forståelse og teknologiske muligheder stræber vi efter at være den foretrukne samarbejdspartner for danske grisedyrlæger og producenter.

Den danske grisebranche står over for betydelige udfordringer og forandringer. Vi ønsker at spille en aktiv rolle i denne udvikling. Derfor søger vi nu enCustomer Engagement Manager – Grisi Danmark. Det er en central markedsvendt rolle, hvor du opbygger stærke relationer baseret på tillid og omsætter indsigt til konkrete resultater.

Som vores grisefaglige ekspert i marken bliver du en betroet samarbejdspartner for dyrlæger og producenter over hele landet. Du får stor indflydelse på kundeaktiviteter, strategiske initiativer og den fortsatte udvikling af vores forretning i Danmark.

Din rolle

Du får ansvar for aktiviteter inden for griseområdet i Danmark og arbejder tæt sammen med engagerede kolleger i det nordiske griseteam. Dine arbejdsdage bliver varierede og vil spænde fra dialog med dyrlæger og besætningsbesøg tilmerestrategisk planlægning og tværgående projekter.

Du får en vigtig rolle i at hjælpe kunder med at navigere i en stadig mere kompleks branche ved at identificere muligheder, udfordre eksisterendetilgangeog understøtte implementeringen af innovative og bæredygtige løsninger.

Dineopgaver består i at:

  • Opbygge og udvikle stærke samarbejder med danske grisedyrlæger og andre vigtige interessenter.

  • Understøtte grisedyrlægernes arbejdei besætningerneved hjælp afdiagnostisksupportoginputtilproblemløsning.

  • Uddanne og trænebesætningsmedarbejdere i optimale vaccinationsrutiner.

  • Omsætte videnskabog analysertil praktiske,værdiskabende løsninger.

  • Deltage irelevanteprojektsamarbejdermedgrisedyrlægerog andre samarbejdspartnere.

  • Samarbejdeinterntpå tværs af funktioner med kolleger inden for Grise-, Livestock-, Marketing-og TechnologySolutions-afdelingerne.

  • Bidrage direkte tilvoressalgs- og aktivitetsmål samt være med til at forme vores langsigtede strategi for griseområdet i Danmark.

Hvem er du?

Du ønsker at kombinere veterinærfaglig ekspertise med en kommerciel og løsningsorienteret tilgang. Du trives i marken, nyder at opbygge relationer og motiveres af at omsætte indsigt til praktiske løsninger hos kunderne.

Du er nysgerrig, omstillingsparat og drives af at hjælpe kunder med at lykkes i en branche under konstant udvikling.

Vi forestiller os, at du har:

  • Kandidatgrad i veterinærmedicin (dyrlæge).

  • Flydende dansk-og engelsk-kundskaberi både skrift og tale.

  • Godt kendskab til dansk griseproduktion.

  • Praktisk erfaring fra grisebranchen, dyrlægepraksis, rådgivning eller en lignende kundeorienteret rolle.

  • En kommerciel og samarbejdsorienteret tilgang samt motivation for at skabe forretningsmæssige resultater.

  • En proaktiv og selvstændig arbejdsstil kombineret med en stærk holdånd.

  • Godvidenskabelig forståelse og kendskab til relevantesygdomsområder.

  • Højt personligt engagement, handlekraft og fokus på resultater.

  • Stærke relationelle og kommunikative kompetencer.

  • En struktureret og datadrevet tilgang samt evnen til at håndtere flere prioriteter samtidigt.

Vi tilbyder

  • En fuldtidsstilling med base i Danmark og hjemmekontor.

  • 70-80 % af arbejdstiden”i marken”iDanmark, med enkelteflerdags-rejser i Norden og Europa.

  • Særdeles gode muligheder for faglig udvikling ogfortsatlæringindenforvores fokusområder.

  • Mulighed for at præge den fremtidige udvikling af vores arbejde med grisesundhed i Danmark.

  • En stærk nordisk teamkultur baseret på tillid, åbenhed, videndeling og omtanke for hinanden.

  • Et miljø, hvor idéer bliver værdsat, ekspertise anerkendt, og hvor ambitionen om at skabe værdi for kunderne driver vores udvikling.

  • Muligheden for at gøre en reel forskel for dyrevelfærd, produktivitet og fremtiden for dansk griseproduktion.

  • En attraktiv lønpakke efter kvalifikationer, inklusive pension, firmabil og hjemmekontorudstyr.

Du bliver en del af et erfarent nordisk griseteam med stærke kompetencer inden for både videnskab,besætningsrådgivning ogkommerciel udvikling. Vi tror på, at de bedste løsninger skabes gennem samarbejde, nysgerrighed og gensidig respekt.

Klar til din næste udfordring?

Har du spørgsmål eller ønsker at høre mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte:

Gitte Blach Nielsen, Swine Business Lead

Telefon: +45 20 18 08 24

jobs.title: Data Platform Administration Architect
jobs.excerpt: The Data Platform Administration Architect is responsible for the architecture, administration, governance, operational excellence, and continuous improvement of the enterprise data platform.
jobs.description:
The Data Platform Administration Architect is responsible for the architecture, administration, governance, operational excellence, and continuous improvement of the enterprise data platform. This role owns the stability, scalability, security, availability, and supportability of cloud-based data platforms, with a primary focus on Databricks, Azure Data Services, and enterprise platform operations.

The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise with strong operational leadership and has extensive experience managing production environments, release processes, change governance, incident response, service management, and platform modernization initiatives. This individual will serve as the technical lead for platform administration while partnering with engineering, infrastructure, security, governance, and business teams to ensure reliable and compliant data platform operations.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the administration, architecture, governance, and operational support of enterprise data platforms.
  • Manage and support Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS), Azure Synapse, Azure SQL, and related Azure services across production and non-production environments.
  • Own platform reliability, availability, performance, scalability, security, and operational excellence.
  • Define and maintain platform standards, environment strategies, monitoring frameworks, operational procedures, and governance controls.
  • Oversee Change Management and Release Management processes, including CRs, SCRs, ECRs, deployment planning, release scheduling, rollback strategies, and post-release validation.
  • Participate in CAB (Change Advisory Board) activities and provide technical assessment, risk evaluation, and deployment readiness recommendations.
  • Lead production support activities, including resolution of Incidents (INC), Service Requests (RITM), Problem Records, and Major Incident Management processes.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams during critical production incidents and ensure timely restoration of services.
  • Perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA) investigations and drive preventative and corrective actions to reduce recurring issues.
  • Develop and maintain operational runbooks, knowledge articles, support documentation, escalation procedures, and disaster recovery plans.
  • Establish and report on operational KPIs including platform uptime, SLA compliance, release success rates, Mean Time to Resolution (MTTR), incident trends, and platform health metrics.
  • Implement and govern CI/CD processes, deployment automation, and infrastructure-as-code best practices.
  • Ensure compliance with enterprise security standards, access governance policies, audit requirements, and SOX controls.
  • Drive platform modernization initiatives, automation opportunities, cost optimization, and continuous service improvement efforts.
  • Mentor platform engineers and administrators while providing technical leadership and architectural direction.

Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of experience in enterprise data platforms, platform engineering, cloud infrastructure, platform administration, or data operations.
  • Hands-on experience administering and supporting Databricks and Azure data platforms in enterprise production environments.
  • Strong expertise with:
    • Databricks
    • Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS)
    • Azure Synapse Analytics
    • Azure SQL
    • Azure Data Factory (ADF)
    • Azure DevOps
    • Azure IAM (RBAC, Service Principals, Managed Identities)
    • Azure Monitor and Log Analytics
  • Proven experience as a Data Platform Administrator, Databricks Administrator, Azure Platform Administrator, Platform Architect, or Platform Operations Lead, not solely a data engineer or application developer.
  • Working knowledge on Jenkins, Maven, Munit, Jmeter, Postman
  • Experience in Open Specification, Swagger
  • Experience in CI/CD Pipeline
  • Strong working knowledge on REST, HTTP, Any point MQ, JSON, XML
  • Hands-on experience with security implementations (OAUTH, SSL, SAML)
  • Working knowledge on Jenkins, Maven, Munit, Jmeter, Postman
  • Experience in working Agile projects
  • 9-10 years of hands-on experience in analysis, design, development, and deployment of large-scale Integration projects preferred
  • Good to have working knowledge on Mulesoft, Azure Service Bus, Oracle Integration Services Experience in importing APIs into API management writing policies, policy expression, setting up authentication, certificates, caching preferred
  • Good to have working knowledge on Azure Service Bus, Oracle Integration Services preferred
  • 2-3 Years of experience the CICD pipeline for Mulesoft deployments using Git Actions preferred
  • Ability to travel up to 25%

jobs.description:
Business Development Manager – Fenestration & Screen Systems

Location: Remote, United States | Convenient access to a major commercial airport preferred
Travel: Regular nationwide travel
Competitive base salary plus performance-based incentive. Additional details will be provided during the recruiting process.

About the Role

Our client, an established international manufacturer of specialty textile and technical material solutions, is seeking an experienced Business Development Manager to drive the continued growth of its premium insect screening product portfolio in the U.S. market.

This opportunity is well suited for a commercially driven professional with experience in insect screening, screen systems, fenestration, shading/sun protection, or a closely related segment of the window and door industry who understands the market, enjoys developing new customer relationships, and is comfortable building business across a nationwide territory.

The company has established a U.S. subsidiary and has already developed initial customer relationships and a growing pipeline of market opportunities. CRM and sales processes, U.S.-based support, product samples, and logistics resources are in place to support continued customer development.

The Business Development Manager will take ownership of the next phase of U.S. market growth, with a focus on expanding the customer and partner base and converting market opportunities into sustainable, recurring business.

As the company’s first dedicated U.S. business development professional, this position offers a high degree of visibility, ownership, and direct access to senior leadership. As the U.S. business grows, the successful candidate will have the opportunity to take on broader commercial responsibilities and play an increasingly important role in shaping the company’s U.S. organization.

The Product & Market Opportunity

The company offers a premium, high-transparency insect screening solution designed to combine strong airflow and visibility with the durability required for everyday residential screening applications.

Following positive initial market response and first commercial traction in the United States, the company is now investing in a dedicated local business development presence to accelerate growth across the U.S. screening and fenestration market.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop new business opportunities across the U.S. market
  • Identify, approach, and acquire new B2B customers and strategic channel partners
  • Build and expand relationships with insect screen system providers, screen fabricators, fenestration distributors, franchise and multi-location screen installation organizations, specialty dealers, and other relevant industry partners
  • Develop selected opportunities with window and door manufacturers and other companies within the broader fenestration value chain
  • Understand customer applications and distribution models and identify opportunities where the company’s screening solutions can add commercial and product value
  • Manage opportunities from initial product introduction and sampling through commercial orders and repeat business
  • Build long-term customer relationships through regular in-person interaction and a consultative sales approach
  • Represent the company at customer meetings, industry trade shows, and relevant market events throughout the United States
  • Monitor market trends, competitive activity, customer requirements, and potential new applications
  • Maintain an accurate sales pipeline and customer activity within the company’s CRM
  • Provide market feedback and customer insights to product and management teams
  • Coordinate closely with the company’s international headquarters, U.S.-based support resources, logistics partners, and other internal stakeholders

Success in this role will be measured by the ability to develop qualified opportunities, acquire new customers, and build sustainable recurring business in the U.S. market.

Candidate Profile

The successful candidate will combine relevant industry knowledge with strong business development and relationship-building capabilities.

Direct insect screen experience is highly valuable, but candidates from closely related market segments who understand the customer base, distribution landscape, and relevant decision-makers are also encouraged to apply.

The ideal candidate brings:

  • Relevant B2B sales or business development experience within insect screening, screen systems, fenestration, shading/sun protection, window and door products, or a closely related market
  • Familiarity with the U.S. fenestration and screening industry and its distribution channels
  • Existing relationships with system providers, screen fabricators, distributors, installation organizations, manufacturers, specialty dealers, or other relevant industry contacts are strongly preferred
  • Proven ability to develop new customers and grow business rather than exclusively manage an established account base
  • Strong relationship-building skills and the ability to engage credibly with business owners, commercial leaders, purchasing teams, and other customer stakeholders
  • A self-directed and entrepreneurial working style combined with the ability to collaborate effectively within an international organization
  • Commercial judgment and the ability to communicate the value of a differentiated technical product
  • Strong presentation, communication, and negotiation skills
  • Comfort using CRM systems
  • Willingness and ability to travel regularly throughout the United States

Experience working with an international or European-headquartered organization is helpful but not required.
