jobs.excerpt: About NewWorldNewWorld is a media company that restores our ability to imagine a world better than the one we inherited.
jobs.description:
About NewWorld

NewWorld is a media company that restores our ability to imagine a world better than the one we inherited. We build the stories, worlds, and communities where that future stops feeling radical and starts feeling popular, possible, and ours to demand and get.

We do this three ways: original shows we own, strategy and Command Center services we deliver for clients, and shows with charitable purpose commissioned through our Media Fund. One studio, one method, one point of view.

What a Creative Command Center does

A Command Center is a small, senior, always-on team that connects four things normally kept apart: research (rigorous information on audiences and what/who they tune into), creators (the people our audiences usually trust more than other institutions), production (content shipped at the speed of the platforms), and amplification (taking the best and most responsive content and moving it creatively through the algorithm).

A Command Center works in two stages. The first is activation, which means identifying the voices a particular audience already trusts and briefing them well enough that they will speak in their own words about something they had not previously been talking about. Those voices are rarely the client's own channels and never paid spokespeople reading from a script. We are connecting to the credibility of creators, commentators, community figures and coalition partners who have standing we cannot manufacture ourselves.

The second stage is amplification, and it is where most creator programs fail. A creator post that reaches only its own following remains a piece of content, while the same post picked up by amplifier accounts, placed behind paid social and digital, pitched into earned media, extended into out-of-home or a live event, and coordinated with distribution partners becomes the conversation itself. Making that happen requires directing a bench of specialist vendors so that their work compounds rather than running in parallel lanes, which is a large part of this job.

The Command Center operates in both directions. Reactive work means breaking a false or predatory story before its frame hardens, on a timeline measured in hours rather than weeks. Proactive work means setting the terms of a conversation before anyone else has the chance to.

Earlier this year we built a Command Center for a candidate facing roughly $10 million in attack spending from pro-AI-industry groups, beginning from almost no name recognition. The work generated 22 million views in a district of 750,000 voters and more than a million engagements, outperforming the industry engagement benchmark by a factor of three and paid engagement by nearly twelve. He finished within four points of winning, and the attack that was meant to end his candidacy became the thing his campaign was best known for.

The role

You will run 1-2 Creative Command Centers. The work involves turning a narrative strategy into an operation that ships on a reliable cadence: setting the operating rhythm and the approval paths, writing and commissioning the briefs, building and managing the roster of trusted voices, and directing the vendors who amplify them so that paid media, creator management, earned media and production are all working from one calendar and one set of metrics. You will also be the senior NewWorld person in the room with the client, which means you are trusted to make decisions without checking first.

The Command Centers coming online over the next year sit in different worlds, including financial confidence, product launches, worker power, gender and identity, product marketing, climate resilience and electoral politics, and we are not looking for a subject-matter expert in any one of them. What we need is someone who has moved between worlds over the course of their own career and can become fluent in a new one quickly, because that adaptation is the job rather than a prelude to it.

Who we are looking for

We are looking for eight to twelve or more years of experience across some combination of creator and influencer strategy, integrated campaign leadership, digital media, cultural and narrative strategy, brand, entertainment production, or rapid response. The shape of the experience matters more to us than the number of years.

  • You have owned something end to end and been accountable for the outcome rather than only the deliverables.
  • You have built a channel or an audience from nothing, whether a YouTube channel, a TikTok account, a newsletter, a podcast, a show or a community. We weight this experience heavily, because it is the difference between commissioning content and understanding why content travels.
  • You have managed creators or talent directly, which means giving feedback that improves the work and holding a standard without flattening someone's voice.
  • You have run integrated campaigns across paid, earned and organic channels, and you have directed outside vendors rather than executing every channel yourself.
  • You write short-form copy exceptionally well. The brief is the product in this role, and a brief that is dense or unclear will not produce anything.
  • You have been the senior person on a client relationship, with the judgment to know when to push a recommendation and when to absorb a decision you disagree with.
  • You stay calm when a moment is live, and you are willing to be fierce without being cruel. We name the company and the decision rather than performing outrage for the algorithm.
  • Your career has moved across worlds in ways that might look scattered on a conventional resume and are precisely what this role requires.

What this role is not

This is a full-time position for someone who wants to build something over a period of years, not a contract or fractional engagement. It is not social media management, and it is not influencer marketing, since reach is the entry cost here rather than the outcome we are measured against. It is also not a role in which someone hands you a finished strategy to coordinate.

Compensation and benefits

The salary range is $130,000 to $165,000, set by experience, and candidates at the upper end of the experience range should expect an offer in the upper half of that band. The role includes full benefits, with health coverage, and paid time off. It is remote and US-based, with the option to work from our New York office.

Equal opportunity

Equity is at the heart of NewWorld. From the clients we partner with to the team we are building, we are committed to creating opportunities for the talented, creative professionals who have been systematically denied them across this industry. Women, people of color, LGBTI people, people of any religion or nationality, and people with disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply.

How to apply

Send a resume along with a note of no more than 400 words responding to a single question: describe a moment when you needed to reach an audience that did not want to hear from you, and explain what you did. We would rather read one specific story than a cover letter.

Candidates who reach the shortlist will be asked to write a sample creator brief from a real prompt, and we pay for the time that takes.

Salary: $130,000 – $165,000

The Short Version: We aren’t building software to sell ads or optimize clicks. At Augintel, we build Natural Language Processing (NLP) software that helps social workers and clinicians read through mountains of messy case notes to find critical, life-saving information about kids and families.

Our tool can help a social worker understand a thousand-page case history in seconds. Because of our software, caseworkers are finding lost grandmothers so kids don't go to foster care, uncovering hidden risks, and quickly spotting if a child urgently needs diabetes medication.
We are a small, tight-knit team of five, and we need a Senior Software Engineer to help us build the infrastructure that makes this all possible.

What You Will Actually Do Here: We need you to build the heavy-lifting software around the AI. You will be working closely with a Machine Learning expert.

  • The Heavy Lifting (70%): The biggest chunk of your work will be building the engine that extracts insights from notes and indexes them for downstream consumers (APIs, our web app). This will entail designing and building pipelines that process millions of case notes reliably and at scale. This backend work is heavily driven by Python.
  • The Infrastructure: You will be configuring and using AWS (specifically ECS, OpenSearch, Lambda, and S3) and writing solid SQL (we use PostgreSQL).
  • The Web App (30%): The remaining portion of your work will involve the front-end user interface and APIs, where you will use TypeScript (React and NodeJS).

Who You Are:

  • You have 5+ years of real-world experience. We are looking for someone who is solidly mid-level (your second or third real job). You aren't an entry-level beginner, but you also aren't looking to be a hands-off architect or on a fast track to management. You just want to write great code and improve your craft.
  • You are independent. We are a remote team. We need someone who can work on their couch, figure things out, and know when to raise their hand for help without flailing.
  • You like talking to people. You will occasionally jump on video calls directly with our clients to troubleshoot issues, stand up new features, or whiteboard solutions. We don't want someone who just wants to sit in a dark closet and write code.
  • You want ownership. You won't just be blindly pulling widgets off a backlog. You will collaborate daily with our ML researcher, product manager, and clients to frame problems and design actual solutions.

The Perks:

  • 100% Remote (US-based). If you happen to be in the Chicago area, great—we have a local nexus here—but it is absolutely not required.
  • Get hands-on experience working right alongside cutting-edge Machine Learning and NLP technology.
  • Go to sleep every night knowing your code is actively keeping kids safe and giving social workers their time back.

If you are a solid Python, Typescript and AWS developer who wants to use your powers for good, we want to talk to you.

jobs.description:
Job Summary:

At the Center for Education Policy Research at Harvard University (CEPR) our mission is to transform education through the power of quality evidence. We believe that if we want to dramatically improve educational outcomes for all children, evidence must play a critical role.

The Math Teaching and Teacher Learning team at CEPR provides math-specific professional development to teachers and coaches to help improve math instruction. Our current grant-funded projects seek to develop and test an expanded math-specific coach training program (M-Powering Teacher Coaching) that uses machine-learning automated feedback and AI-enhanced coaching tools. The Data Scientist will contribute to this and other projects that connect rigorous educational research with practical tools for teachers, instructional coaches, and education leaders. This person will oversee, manage, and lead analysis and application of complex datasets, and contribute to the integration of research insights into innovative educational tools and cutting-edge products. They will be joining a team with faculty lead and Principal Investigator, Heather Hill, and collaborators at higher education research institutions, professional learning organizations, curriculum providers, and Enterprise AI firm(s).

Job-Specific Responsibilities:

Key responsibilities of the Data Scientist include:

Data and Research Infrastructure:

  • Organizes, cleans, and prepares structured and unstructured data (e.g., video, audio, text) for AI modeling and analysis.
  • Develops and documents codebooks, annotation protocols, data dictionaries, and other research procedures.
  • Builds and documents reproducible workflows for data processing, annotation, statistical analysis, and modeling.
  • Supports shared practices for version control, code review, data security, and reproducible research.
  • Maintains organized project files, code repositories, data documentation, and analytic records.

Analysis and Measurement Development

  • Conduct data science work across grant-funded projects focused on teaching, instructional coaching, curriculum, and artificial intelligence in education.
  • Applies statistical, machine learning, natural language processing, and generative AI methods as appropriate.
  • Coordinates and executes the development and evaluation of automated measures related to teaching, coaching, curriculum implementation, and teacher learning.
  • Supports pilot studies and evaluation activities related to usability, implementation, coaching, and teacher experience.

Product Development and Dissemination

  • Helps integrate research measures and findings into education tools and user interfaces.
  • Contributes to research papers, reports, public goods, funder deliverables, and other project materials (e.g., tables, figures, visualization, presentations, and technical documentation)

Project Management and Cross-team Collaboration

  • Manages timelines and deliverables across one or more grant-funded workstreams
  • Collaborates with researchers, educators, software developers, and external partners such as Enterprise AI firm(s) to support project goals.
  • Oversees internal working groups to deliver on tasks and milestones

Performs other duties as assigned.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, Mathematics, Education, Social Science, or a related field.
  • Relevant experience, which may include professional, research, internship, or concurrent-with-baccalaureate experience in data science, statistical programming, machine learning, educational research, or a related field.
  • Must have strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and collaboratively.
  • Occasional travel may be required to support project meetings, trainings, pilot activities, or other research-related events.
  • Candidates should submit a resume or curriculum vitae and cover letter describing their relevant experience and interest in the position.
  • All candidates invited to the in-person/hybrid interview may be asked to complete a task and/or submit a sample program.

This is a full-time, one-year term appointment beginning on the date of hire, with the possibility of continuation based on funding, performance, and departmental needs.

The work arrangement is remote, subject to project and departmental needs.

Additional Qualifications and Skills:

  • Master’s degree in data science, statistics, computer science, education, economics, social science, or a related field preferred.
  • Experience with R, Python, Stata, or a similar programming language preferred.
  • Experience with machine learning, natural language processing, generative AI, or automated scoring strongly preferred.
  • Experience with data annotation, codebook development, or qualitative and quantitative coding preferred.
  • Familiarity with building reproducible workflows for data cleaning, processing, analysis, or modeling preferred.
  • Familiarity with version control, databases, APIs, or collaborative software development preferred.
  • Experience with K-12 education data or education research is a plus.
  • Experience with mathematics teaching and learning is a plus.
  • Interest in improving education through responsible and evidence-based uses of artificial intelligence; commitment to equity, diversity, inclusion, and belonging.
  • Appointment End Date: One year from date of hire
  • Standard Hours/Schedule: 35 hours per week
  • Compensation Range/Rate (including Shift Differential if applicable): $90,000 - $95,000 commensurate with experience
  • Visa Sponsorship Information: Harvard University is unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position
  • Pre-Employment Screening: Identity and Education

Work Format Details

This position has been determined by school or unit leaders that the duties and responsibilities can effectively be performed fully remotely at a non-Harvard location. Employees in fully remote positions must work all scheduled hours in a Harvard registered state in compliance with the University’s Policy on Employment Outside of Massachusetts. At the discretion of the department, fully remote employees may occasionally be required on site at a Harvard location. Certain visa types and funding sources may limit work location. By working at Harvard University, you join a vibrant community that advances Harvard's world-changing mission in meaningful ways, inspires innovation and collaboration, and builds skills and expertise. We are dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming environment where everyone can thrive.

Why join the Harvard Graduate School of Education?

The Harvard Graduate School of Education (HGSE) is a diverse community of learners, teachers, and employees who are passionate about changing the world through education and striving for maximum impact in the field of education.

TWF has built the scaffolding for federal work. MBE certification, SAM.gov registration, two operational divisions ready to serve federal contracts, a credentialed bench, and signed commercial customers proving the operating model. What is missing is the capture function. This engagement is for the operator who knows how to walk a federal opportunity from first signal through awarded contract, and who wants to build that function inside a firm where it does not exist yet.

What is already built

The Wilkinson Firm is a workforce strategy and staffing firm headquartered across NC and Atlanta. We launched in April 2025 and are now in Year 2 of operations. Two operational divisions today (HR Advisory for the mental health industry, Premium Hospitality and Event Staffing). Government Contracting division being formally stood up this quarter. Hourly consulting rate, three tiers calibrated to experience and scope:

  • Director ($200-350/hr): Established capture directors with documented win history on $1M+ contracts

Engagement is hourly. Time commitment scales with pipeline activity, typically 10-40 hours per week. Win-based bonus stack negotiable on top of hourly rate for awarded contracts the engagement materially drove.

  • Day 180: 2-4 proposals submitted. First award or shortlist position. Win rate baseline established.

Who you are

  • Shipley-trained or equivalent. SAM.gov fluent. Comfortable with FAR/DFARS terminology

  3. Reference checks (3+ professional references) and work history verification

2-4 weeks first conversation to active engagement.

What we believe

Trust before revenue. Mission before money. Real seats, real upside. We build durable federal relationships through earned credibility. We win together. We pay people in real numbers, not pizza parties. We are building something great and we want partners who feel the same.

Job Description: Chief KYC (Know Your Customer) Officer (CKYCO)

Industry: Banking, Financial Services, Insurance, Investment

Job Type: Full-Time

Reporting To: Chief Compliance Officer (CCO) / Chief AML Officer (CAMLO) / Chief Risk Officer (CRO)

Job Summary

The Chief KYC Officer (CKYCO) is responsible for overseeing the organization's KYC, Customer Due Diligence (CDD), and onboarding frameworks to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and effective management of customer-related risks.

This role plays a critical part in preventing financial crime by ensuring robust customer identification, verification, and risk assessment processes across all business lines.

Key Responsibilities

1. KYC Strategy & Framework

Develop and implement enterprise-wide KYC/CDD strategies and frameworks

Ensure alignment with AML/CFT regulations and organizational policies

Establish risk-based customer onboarding and due diligence processes

Continuously enhance KYC practices to address emerging risks

2. Customer Due Diligence (CDD/EDD)

Oversee CDD and Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) processes

Ensure accurate customer identification, verification, and risk profiling

Manage onboarding of high-risk customers and complex cases

Ensure compliance with regulatory KYC requirements

3. KYC Operations & Process Management

Oversee end-to-end KYC operations, including onboarding, periodic reviews, and remediation

Improve operational efficiency and turnaround time for KYC processes

Standardize KYC procedures across business units

Monitor and resolve KYC backlogs and issues

4. Regulatory Compliance & Reporting

Ensure compliance with KYC-related regulatory requirements

Support AML and compliance teams in regulatory reporting and audits

Maintain audit-ready documentation and records

Monitor regulatory changes impacting KYC processes

5. Risk Assessment & Monitoring

Conduct customer risk assessments and segmentation

Monitor high-risk customers, PEPs, and complex client structures

Identify and mitigate customer-related risks

Align KYC practices with enterprise risk frameworks

6. Technology & KYC Automation

Oversee KYC systems, tools, and digital onboarding platforms

Drive automation and digital transformation in KYC processes

Implement data analytics and AI tools for customer risk assessment

Ensure integration with AML and transaction monitoring systems

7. Stakeholder Collaboration

Collaborate with AML, compliance, risk, and business teams

Support front-line teams in customer onboarding and due diligence

Liaise with regulators, auditors, and external stakeholders

Provide KYC insights and reporting to leadership

8. Leadership & Team Management

Lead and develop KYC operations and compliance teams

Establish performance standards and KPIs

Foster a culture of compliance, accuracy, and efficiency

Support talent development and succession planning

Key Requirements

Education

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Business Administration, Law, or related field

Professional certifications such as CAMS, ICA, or equivalent are highly preferred

Experience

10–15+ years of experience in KYC, AML, compliance, or financial crime roles

Proven experience in senior KYC leadership roles (e.g., Head of KYC, KYC Director)

Strong experience in banking, financial services, insurance, or investment sectors

Skills & Competencies

Deep knowledge of KYC/CDD/EDD processes and AML regulations

Strong understanding of customer risk profiling and onboarding frameworks

Expertise in KYC operations and process optimization

Analytical and problem-solving skills

Leadership and team management

Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement

Attention to detail and compliance mindset

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

KYC onboarding turnaround time

Accuracy and completeness of customer records

Reduction in KYC backlogs and remediation cases

Compliance with regulatory requirements

Audit and regulatory inspection outcomes

Customer onboarding experience and satisfaction

Preferred Attributes

Experience in multinational or highly regulated financial institutions

Exposure to digital KYC, eKYC, and regtech solutions

Strong collaboration with AML, compliance, and risk teams

Ability to manage high-volume KYC operations

Compensation & Benefits

Competitive executive salary

Performance-based incentives

Executive benefits and allowances

MBE-certified professional services firms are systematically underfunded.

Who we are not for

  • Generalist business development professionals without specific capital network

line: MBE Capital Connector - [Your Network Focus]

jobs.excerpt: Role SummaryRevamp is seeking a 3D Electrical Design Engineer III to lead the development and coordination of 3D models for utility-scale battery energy storage systems (BESS) and solar photovoltaic (PV) projects.
jobs.description:
Role Summary

Revamp is seeking a 3D Electrical Design Engineer III to lead the development and coordination of 3D models for utility-scale battery energy storage systems (BESS) and solar photovoltaic (PV) projects. The models you produce become the drawings construction teams use, so accuracy, constructability, and sound technical judgment directly support safe, timely project delivery.

In this role, you will independently lead significant portions of complex projects and coordinate several assignments at once. You will formulate and solve multidisciplinary layout challenges, review deliverables, mentor designers, and represent 3D design work in client and project meetings. Working with civil, structural, and electrical engineers. And construction stakeholders, you will help Revamp deliver purpose-built, impact driven designs that advance utility-scale renewable generation.

Duties & responsibilities

Core technical & functional responsibilities

  • Contribute to the development, coordination, and maintenance of complex 3D models, layouts, and renderings for utility-scale PV and BESS projects in Autodesk Inventor.
  • Develop production-ready 3D representations of battery energy storage systems, inverters, transformers, switchgear, cable management systems, equipment pads, racking, structural supports, and balance-of-system components.
  • Formulate and solve electrical layout challenges involving cable routing, cable management systems, conduit and trench coordination, equipment clearances, grounding, and equipment interconnections.
  • Own assigned project models, including model organization, revision control, file management, and documentation integrity throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Resolve spatial conflicts, constructability issues, and interface conditions among civil, electrical, structural, and mechanical disciplines.
  • Produce and review sheet sets, technical drawings, details, and renderings derived from 3D models.
  • Contribute to the development of modeling techniques, templates, libraries, and automation approaches that improve design quality and throughput.
  • Participate in evaluating emerging modeling technologies and digital engineering workflows, and recommend practical applications for project teams.

Project & portfolio execution

  • 3D design coordination for multiple concurrent PV and BESS projects or significant portions of complex projects.
  • Assist in developing scopes, level-of-effort estimates, schedules, resource needs, and technical assumptions for 3D design activities with guidance when needed.
  • Identify technical risks, coordination conflicts, and schedule impacts early, and recommend a path to project leadership.
  • Support fabrication, procurement, and installation planning with coordinated, constructible models that align with project requirements.

Quality, Standards & Compliance

  • Review models, drawings, and design deliverables through formal quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC) processes for technical accuracy, completeness, and constructability.
  • Review vendor- and client-supplied models before incorporation, and document discrepancies for resolution.
  • Confirm that assigned work conforms to company standards, client requirements, applicable industry codes, and jurisdictional regulations.

Mentorship & people leadership

  • Coordinate designers assigned to project deliverables and align their work with project schedules and priorities.
  • Develop training materials, technical documentation, and lessons learned that strengthen consistent practice across the team.

Collaboration & communication

  • Coordinate model interfaces and constructability with civil, structural, electrical engineers, and construction stakeholders.
  • Present models and visualizations in client design reviews, and answer questions about equipment layout, cable routing, and constructability decisions.
  • Advise project managers and discipline leads on modeling strategy, sequencing, and technical trade-offs in project meetings.

Additional responsibilities

  • Perform essential duties including meeting deliverables and deadlines.
  • Perform additional related duties as assigned or directed.

Experience, knowledge, skills, & abilities

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, engineering technology, design, drafting/CADD, or related technical discipline, or similar applicable work experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in electrical engineering design, technical design, or drafting for power generation, industrial, or infrastructure projects.
  • Minimum 5 years of professional experience using Autodesk Inventor or equivalent software to prepare 3D infrastructure designs, in a professional design environment.
  • Electrical design experience involving cable routing, cable management, grounding, equipment interconnections, and equipment layout for large-scale power generation or comparable industrial projects.
  • Experience coordinating design work across civil, electrical, and structural disciplines.
  • Experience producing and reviewing sheet sets and design documentation derived from 3D models.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead multiple concurrent assignments with limited guidance and exercise sound technical judgment.

Preferred

  • Experience with utility-scale BESS and solar PV projects.
  • Advanced experience with AutoCAD or related Autodesk design tools.
  • Knowledge of direct current and alternating current systems, cable schedules, conduit and trenching, cable tray, grounding, and equipment interconnection.
  • Familiarity with the National Electrical Code (NEC), National Electrical Safety Code (NESC), Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers (IEEE) standards, or related electrical and safety standards.
  • Experience mentoring designers or supporting client-facing design reviews and technical coordination meetings.

Benefits for full-time positions

  • Participation in Revamp's Employee Ownership ESOP program.
  • Competitive compensation with bonus.
  • Full benefits package offerings including 99% employer-paid health, vision, life, and dental insurance.
  • Medical, dependent care, and commuter FSA.
  • Monthly health and wellness stipend.
  • Attractive vacation, sick, and holiday pay.
  • Paid parental leave.
  • 401(k) savings plan with 100% match up to 6%, vested immediately.
  • Paid volunteer time off and charitable donation matching.

About Revamp

Founded in 2016, Revamp is the premier employee-owned engineering design firm dedicated to advancing large-scale renewable energy projects. Our team is united by a shared commitment to accelerating the global energy transition and creating a workplace where talented people can make a tangible impact in the fight against climate change.

As employee-owners, we take pride in building a culture of collaboration, innovation, and accountability where every individual's contribution drives both company success and personal growth. Revamp engineers have supported the design of more than 10% of the utility-scale solar generation capacity in the U.S. since 2020, contributing directly to the renewable energy transformation.

So much more than just an engineering firm, we are a diverse, international team of artists, singers, dancers, pastry chefs, outdoor enthusiasts, animal lovers, travelers, and problem-solvers who bring curiosity and creativity to everything we do. For more information, visit www.revamp-eng.com.

Disclaimers

Revamp Engineering Inc. is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive workplace. We provide equal employment opportunities without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. We value diversity and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. Revamp Engineering Inc. is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you require an accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us.

Salary: $110,700 – $137,300 / year

jobs.description:
Engagement type: Independent consultant, 1099 hourly.
Rate range: $100 - $500 per hour, based on experience and scope (three-tier band detailed below).
Time commitment: Part-time or fractional, scales with pipeline (typically 10-40 hrs/week).
Location: Remote with quarterly DC travel preferred.
Reports to: GovCon Division Lead.

A note from the founder

TWF has built the scaffolding for federal work. MBE certification, SAM.gov registration, two operational divisions ready to serve federal contracts, a credentialed bench, and signed commercial customers proving the operating model. What is missing is the capture function. This engagement is for the operator who knows how to walk a federal opportunity from first signal through awarded contract, and who wants to build that function inside a firm where it does not exist yet.

What is already built

The Wilkinson Firm is a workforce strategy and staffing firm headquartered across NC and Atlanta. We launched in April 2025 and are now in Year 2 of operations. Two operational divisions today (HR Advisory for the mental health industry, Premium Hospitality and Event Staffing). Government Contracting division being formally stood up this quarter. Three active staffing contracts in delivery. FY26 trajectory $425-525K. Zero loans, zero institutional debt. Defined path to $5M+ over the next 24 months.

Federal-relevant scaffolding:[- Two operational divisions ready to serve federal contracts in HHS-adjacent verticals (VA mental health programs, DoD behavioral health support, HHS workforce IDIQs) and hospitality (federal lodging, on-base food service, training facility F&B).

What you own

  • Federal opportunity identification and qualification across SAM.gov, GSA Schedules, agency forecasts, and prime/sub channels
  • Capture-to-proposal lifecycle: opportunity assessment, teaming strategy, technical and price strategy, color-team reviews, submission readiness
  • Capture playbook documentation: pursuit criteria, gate reviews, win themes, ghosting strategy, competitive analysis
  • Prime and sub partner relationships and government POC management
  • Set-aside strategy and certification work (8(a), HUBZone, WOSB, SDVOSB) in coordination with the GovCon Division Lead
  • Pipeline visibility and reporting to firm leadership
  • Coaching the Proposal Manager and Federal Account Executive seats as they come online

Engagement structure

Hourly consulting rate, three tiers calibrated to experience and scope:

  • Foundational ($100-200/hr): Capture managers with 5-8 years experience, ramping into a director role
  • Director ($200-350/hr): Established capture directors with documented win history on $1M+ contracts
  • Principal ($350-500/hr): Senior capture principals with multi-million-dollar award history and Tier 1 prime experience

Engagement is hourly. Time commitment scales with pipeline activity, typically 10-40 hours per week. Win-based bonus stack negotiable on top of hourly rate for awarded contracts the engagement materially drove.

Success milestones

  • Day 30: Capture playbook drafted. Pursuit gate criteria documented. Initial pipeline of 10+ qualified opportunities.
  • Day 90: 2-4 active captures in formal pursuit. First teaming agreements signed. Pipeline value $1M+.
  • Day 180: 2-4 proposals submitted. First award or shortlist position. Win rate baseline established.

Who you are

  • 7-15 years in federal capture, proposal management, or BD for small to mid-size GovCon firms
  • Documented track record capturing $1M+ federal contracts
  • Shipley-trained or equivalent. SAM.gov fluent. Comfortable with FAR/DFARS terminology
  • Familiar with small business set-asides and the certification lifecycle
  • Past performance citations in workforce, HHS-adjacent, hospitality, or staffing services preferred
  • Comfortable building a function from scratch inside a founder-led firm
  • Located in DC, NC, GA, or willing to travel to DC quarterly

Bonus points

  • Prior role at a Tier 1 GovCon prime or boutique capture firm
  • Existing relationships at DoD, VA, HHS, GSA, or DHS
  • APMP credential
  • Track record of managed HUBZone or 8(a) certifications

How we will get to know each other

  1. Initial 30-minute fit conversation with the GovCon Division Lead
  2. Working session: walk through a real federal opportunity or proposal scenario we are actively considering
  3. Reference checks (3+ professional references) and work history verification
  4. Engagement letter, scope of work, and rate confirmation
  5. Kickoff within 7 days of signed engagement

2-4 weeks first conversation to active engagement.

What we believe

Trust before revenue. Mission before money. Real seats, real upside. We build durable federal relationships through earned credibility. We win together. We pay people in real numbers, not pizza parties. We are building something great and we want partners who feel the same.

Application tips

  1. Visit , ,
  2. Find The Wilkinson Firm on LinkedIn
  3. In your cover note, answer two questions: (1) what kind of GovCon engagement model works best for you (project-based, retained hours, hybrid), and (2) one example of a federal pursuit, proposal, or account you would point to as your strongest reference work

What to expect from us

jobs.description:
Technical Marketing Lead — Growth, Lifecycle & CRO

Fully Remote · Full-Time · Reports to VP of Growth Marketing

About the Role

At Sage Haus, we help families find the support they need to make everyday life feel more manageable. We’re looking for a full-stack technical growth marketer to help more families find us—and make every step that follows feel clear, helpful, and personal.

You’ll own the demand side of our funnel, from the website through lifecycle to digital products. This is a hands-on role with room to build, experiment, and see the impact of your work. You’ll write the email, build the flow, read the dashboard, fix the landing page, and brief the ad—sometimes all in the same day.

You’re comfortable across the channel mix, technical enough to build your own automations, and curious enough to learn what you haven’t done before. You know when to dig into the data and when to ship a first version and learn from it.

Your first priority will be getting our lifecycle and CRM foundations working well: auditing existing flows, establishing a reliable baseline, and shipping the fixes with the highest revenue impact. From there, you’ll take on broader conversion ownership—from first site visit to booked call, attended call, deposit, and subscription.

You’ll work closely with our VP of Growth Marketing, to turn ideas into better experiences for families and measurable growth for Sage Haus.

You’re a Great Fit If…

  • You’ve owned a full demand funnel end to end—not just one channel inside it—and can talk through what you built, what you changed, and what happened next.
  • You build your own automations and flows. You’re comfortable in tools like Make, Zapier, Flodesk, Klaviyo, or ActiveCampaign, and you’re willing to learn whatever helps you get the job done.
  • You can write the email, build the reminder sequence, and figure out why people are booking calls but not showing up.
  • You’re comfortable getting under the hood of a landing page, form, or booking flow, spotting friction, and shipping a fix.
  • You trust data over instinct. You can pull the number, chart it, explain what it means, and change the plan when the results tell you to.
  • You use AI to move faster, solve problems, and learn new skills. For us, it’s a workflow tool—not a replacement for thoughtful, human content.
  • You’d rather ship a version 1 today than perfect a version 3 in a quarter. You know how to prioritize, test, learn, and keep moving.
  • You care about the families behind the funnel. You want the experience to feel clear, helpful, and personal from the first click onward.

Bonus: You’ve worked in a two-sided marketplace, subscription/app business, or household services. You’re comfortable connecting the dots across paid media, sales, content, and SEO.

Compensation & Benefits

  • $100,000–$130,000 annually on a full-time-equivalent basis, depending on experience and qualifications.

We’re looking for someone who can grow with Sage Haus. This role is intended to be full-time, but we’re open to starting part-time and building toward full-time together if that makes the transition easier. We’ll agree on hours, prorated compensation, and a ramp-up timeline before you begin.

Schedule & Work Environment

  • Fully remote: Work where you do your best work.
  • 30–40 hours per week: A flexible schedule, with agreed time together for team meetings and collaboration.
  • Room to ramp up: We’re open to an initial part-time schedule with a clear path to full-time.
  • Ownership and collaboration: You’ll have room to run with your work, alongside a team that shares ideas, solves problems, and keeps families at the center.

Interview Process

We want to get to know how you think, what you’ve built, and what you’re looking for next—and give you a chance to get to know us, too. Here’s what you can expect:

  1. A quick introduction — 15 minutes. We’ll talk about your background, what drew you to Sage Haus, and practical details like availability and compensation.
  2. A short technical exercise. A chance to show how you approach the kind of work you’d do here. We’ll share clear instructions and the expected time commitment in advance.
  3. A conversation with our leadership team — 20–30 minutes. We’ll dig into your experience, how you work with others, and how you tackle a problem when the answer isn’t obvious.
  4. A final conversation with Nelson, our VP of Growth Marketing. We’ll talk through your approach, what you’d take on first, and any remaining questions on either side before we make a hiring decision.

How to Apply

If you’re passionate about helping families, enjoy connecting people, and are excited about the Sage Haus mission, we’d love to hear from you. Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter explaining why you’d be a great fit for this role.

Salary: $100,000 – $130,000 / year

jobs.excerpt: Independent Music Artist – Early Platform Programme Location: Remote / Global Engagement: Independent Artist Programme Earnings: Direct artist earnings through platform participation Initial Cohort: Limited to approximately 100 artists Our client, an innovative music technology start-up, is seeking ambitious independent music artists to join the first cohort of artists on its new music and fan-engagement platform.
jobs.description:
Independent Music Artist – Early Platform Programme

Location: Remote / Global
Engagement: Independent Artist Programme
Earnings: Direct artist earnings through platform participation
Initial Cohort: Limited to approximately 100 artists

Our client, an innovative music technology start-up, is seeking ambitious independent music artists to join the first cohort of artists on its new music and fan-engagement platform.

This opportunity is specifically designed for artists who consider their music to be a serious part of their career and want to build sustainable income from their creativity.

The platform has been built around a simple belief:

Artists should not need millions of streams before their music starts generating meaningful income.

Instead of relying solely on passive streaming, the platform enables artists to build direct relationships with the people who genuinely support their work and monetise that community.

You do not need thousands of followers to be considered. You do, however, need a minimum of 10 genuine supporters who you reasonably believe would actively support your music if they were given the opportunity to support you directly.

These could be existing fans, friends, family or people already following your musical journey.

As an example, 100 genuine supporters on our client's platform could generate an artist at least US$400 per month in recurring income.

For many independent artists, significantly larger streaming audiences currently generate far less.

The question is therefore not simply:

How many people listen to my music?

It is:

How many people genuinely support me as an artist?

Our client is initially looking to select approximately 100 independent artists to join the platform ahead of its wider rollout.

Mandatory Application Questions

All questions must be answered. Applications submitted without the requested information may be automatically rejected.

  1. Are you currently an independent music artist, and have you previously released original music publicly?
    Yes / No
  2. Please provide a link to your Spotify, Apple Music or other main artist profile.
  3. Approximately how many monthly listeners do you currently have?
  4. Please provide links to your main artist social media profiles and state approximately how many followers you have.
  5. Do you have a minimum of 10 people who you genuinely believe would financially support your music if they had the opportunity to support you directly rather than simply listening through a streaming platform?

    Yes / No

    If yes, approximately how many genuine supporters do you believe you currently have?

  6. Did you earn any income from your music during the last 12 months?
    Yes / No
  7. Approximately how much did you earn from music streaming during the last 12 months?
  8. Roughly how much did you earn in total from your music and music-related social media activity during the last 12 months?

Key Responsibilities

As one of the first artists selected for the platform, you will be expected to:

  • Create and maintain an active artist profile.
  • Upload and showcase your music and relevant artist content.
  • Introduce your existing supporters to the platform.
  • Bring a minimum of 10 genuine supporters onto the platform.
  • Engage regularly with your supporters and build your artist community.
  • Make active use of the platform's artist monetisation tools.
  • Promote your music and platform presence through your existing channels.
  • Explore and use the functionality made available to you.
  • Provide constructive feedback on your experience where requested.
  • Participate in occasional testing, surveys or feedback sessions during the initial rollout.
  • Report technical or user-experience issues where identified.
  • Treat your artist presence, audience and earning opportunities professionally.
  • Where appropriate, introduce other credible independent artists within your network who may also benefit from joining the platform.

Requirements

To be considered, you should:

  • Be an independent music artist actively pursuing or developing a career in music.
  • Have previously created, recorded or released original music.
  • Have music available online that we can review.
  • Have an existing audience or community, even if that audience is currently small.
  • Have a minimum of 10 genuine supporters who you reasonably believe would actively support your music through the platform.
  • Be willing to introduce those supporters to the platform.
  • Be comfortable engaging directly with your audience rather than relying solely on passive streaming.
  • Be willing to actively use the platform and its artist tools.
  • Be reliable, responsive and serious about developing your music career.
  • Be open to providing occasional feedback during the early stages of the platform's rollout.

Ideal Artist Profile

We are not necessarily looking for the artists with the largest following.

An artist with 50,000 followers but little genuine engagement is not automatically more suitable than an artist with 500 followers and 50 people who genuinely care about their music.

We are interested in real audiences, not vanity metrics.

You may currently have 50 monthly listeners or 50,000.

What matters is whether people genuinely care about your music and whether you are prepared to build a direct relationship with them.

You are likely to be someone who:

  • Takes your music career seriously.
  • Is actively building an audience independently.
  • Understands that a successful independent music career requires building a community as well as releasing music.
  • Has people who regularly listen to, comment on, share or otherwise support your work.
  • Is comfortable promoting yourself and communicating directly with your audience.
  • Wants greater control over how you monetise your music.
  • Wants to reduce your reliance on streaming royalties alone.
  • Is prepared to be proactive in developing your career and generating income from your creativity.

Earnings & Artist Benefits

Selected artists will have the opportunity to earn directly through the platform by developing and monetising their supporter community.

As part of the initial artist cohort, you will also receive:

  • Early access to the full platform.
  • Access to all artist functionality available during the initial rollout.
  • Access to certain features that may become paid or premium services for artists joining the platform in future.
  • The opportunity to establish and grow your artist presence before the platform's wider public rollout.
  • The ability to begin generating income directly from your supporters from the outset.
  • Greater direct engagement with the people who support your music.
  • The opportunity to provide feedback that may influence future artist functionality.
  • Access to a growing community of independent artists and music supporters.
  • Priority consideration for artist performance opportunities at the platform's planned 2028/2029 music festival.
  • The opportunity to recommend other credible independent artists from your network for consideration.
  • Remote participation from anywhere in the world.

There is no fee to apply or participate in the initial programme.

Why This Matters

For independent artists, having listeners does not necessarily mean having income.

Our client wants to change that.

Rather than asking artists to spend years chasing enormous streaming numbers before their work generates meaningful returns, the platform has been designed to make smaller, highly engaged communities economically valuable.

If 100 people genuinely value your music enough to support you directly, those 100 people could generate at least US$400 in recurring monthly incomethrough the platform.

That changes the question from:

How do I get millions of streams?

to:

How do I find and build relationships with the people who genuinely value what I create?

Interested?

If you are serious about building your music career, have already started developing an audience and believe you have at least 10 people who would genuinely support you, we would like to hear from you.

Complete all mandatory application questions and provide the requested links to your music and social media profiles.

You don't need a huge audience.

You need a real one.

As a Senior AI Engineer, you build the control layer behind that shift: AI Controllers, reusable templates, and workflow primitives that translate brand intent into deterministic, production-ready outputs.

This is not prompt engineering. This is designing systems that constrain, guide, and scale generative models into reliable creative production pipelines used by global brands.

Requirements

What You Will Do

Build AI-Controlled Content Systems

  • Architect and ship AI Controllers that encode visual logic (composition, layout, constraints) into reusable systems

  • Translate creative direction into structured pipelines (e.g., turning logo safe zones into enforceable spatial constraints)

  • Design templates that produce consistent outputs across thousands of variations

Develop and Scale AI Workflows

  • Build and optimize ComfyUI pipelines integrating multiple models, refiners, and control mechanisms

  • Combine segmentation, depth maps, and latent constraints to guide generation toward production-grade outputs

  • Iterate on workflows based on output quality, failure modes, and client requirements

Own Model Behavior and Output Quality

  • Work hands-on with diffusion models, encoders, and latent space manipulation

  • Define how prompts, conditioning, and control signals interact across the pipeline

  • Ensure outputs meet brand and visual standards—not just “good images,” but usable assets

Extend Platform Capabilities

  • Contribute to new node definitions and AI capabilities within Grip’s platform

  • Specify technical requirements for new features across Python/PyTorch systems

  • Collaborate with engineers and creative teams to push what’s possible in automated content generation

Who You Are

You build systems that make AI predictable, controllable, and production-ready—especially in visual domains.

You Have:

  • Strong experience with generative AI systems (diffusion models, conditioning, latent space control)

  • Hands-on work in ComfyUI or similar node-based pipelines

  • Solid programming skills (Python, PyTorch) with experience shipping working systems

  • Experience training or fine-tuning models and managing their lifecycle

  • Exposure to visual tools like Photoshop, Blender, or similar (not optional thinking—actual usage)

You Think:

  • In systems, not prompts—how components interact, fail, and scale

  • In constraints—how to guide models toward predictable outputs

  • In outputs—what makes something production-ready vs. visually interesting

  • Pragmatically—you ship working solutions and refine based on results

Your Skills Are:

  • Translating abstract creative direction into structured AI workflows

  • Debugging generation pipelines across multiple control layers

  • Balancing flexibility with control in template systems

  • Communicating across engineering and creative teams

Why Join Grip?

The Platform Position.
Grip is infrastructure for enterprise creative production—powering global brands to generate content at scale with control and consistency.

The Market Timing.
AI-generated content is moving from experimentation to production. The challenge is no longer generation—it’s control, reliability, and scale.

jobs.excerpt: Assigning Editor: Trending & Viral NewsAbout The Mary Sue and We Got This CoveredThe Mary Sue and We Got This Covered are looking for a highly skilled and motivated assigning editor to take our story sourcing, pitching, and article curation to the next level, with a focus on social-first stories and syndicated news.
jobs.description:
Assigning Editor: Trending & Viral News

About The Mary Sue and We Got This Covered

The Mary Sue and We Got This Covered are looking for a highly skilled and motivated assigning editor to take our story sourcing, pitching, and article curation to the next level, with a focus on social-first stories and syndicated news.

We cover everything from major political news to the latest celebrity drama and the week’s biggest streaming hits. We also tell real stories about real people, like an everyday post on social media that hasn't yet caught anyone else's attention. This variety is the key to our success, and the right candidate should be comfortable sourcing and pitching engaging stories from all corners of the internet as well as major trending news.

We aim to share stories with our audience that really get them thinking, talking, and sharing them organically rather than relying on traditional SEO. We want someone who is excited about doing things a little differently and has a hunger for finding the next big story.

About The Role

As the Assigning Editor, you will be in charge of the first, and one of the most crucial, steps when it comes to formulating an engaging or thought-provoking article. You’ll lead story sourcing and pitching for our social and viral news desk across multiple brands and spend much of your day digging into the major trending news stories that people really care about, or digging through TikTok (as well as Reddit and other social media platforms), spotting posts and conversations that have the makings of a big story. To excel, you’ll have a natural ability to spot the story in something that others would scroll straight past and know how to frame it so it reaches a wide audience.

This is a fast-paced, high-volume role, which will best fit someone who is comfortable pitching a large number of stories every day while using data (and natural instinct) to inform decisions over time.

What You'll Do

  • Keep abreast of major world events, the latest news in the world of entertainment, and understand how to frame these topics in new and interesting ways that will resonate with our audiences
  • Monitor TikTok and other social platforms every day to find stories, ideally before other publishers do
  • Write clear pitches and context to give writers everything they need before starting on an article
  • Assign stories to staff and freelance writers
  • Frame stories and headlines for syndication and social platforms like MSN, Facebook, and SmartNews
  • Track performance and use data to refine your pitches
  • Build and document discovery workflows, so writers and other editors can become stronger pitchers
  • Verify that stories are accurate, credit creators properly, and treat the people in our stories fairly
  • Work with the wider editorial team to spot stories that deserve extra attention, follow-ups, or investigation

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as an assigning, commissioning, news, trending, or social editor in a fast-moving digital media environment (or extensive experience as a self-pitching writer)
  • A genuine love for the weird and wonderful worlds of TikTok and social culture, with a strong instinct for what people will want to read and a passion for exploring new niches
  • Syndication and/or social media experience is a strong plus
  • Excellent, compelling headline writing without being misleading
  • Comfortable working with traffic data and using it to guide editorial decisions
  • An ability to work in a fast-paced, high-volume pitching environment
  • A strong understanding of ethical journalism
  • A strong understanding of US culture and audiences

Think you can spot the next big story before anyone else? Please send us your resume, along with a cover letter that tells us who you are and what makes you a good fit for this role. We'd also love to see three social posts or stories you've come across recently that you think would make a great article, with a headline for each and a line on why you picked it.

Equal Opportunities

The Mary Sue and We Got This Covered are committed to being inclusive and welcoming places to work. We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, including but not limited to race, ethnicity, national origin, age, disability, religion, gender identity and expression, and sexual orientation. LGBTQI+ candidates are warmly welcomed and encouraged to apply.

Job Title: Gestionnaire d'essais cliniques II/CTM II, IQVIA Biotech

Job Location: Kirkland, Quebec, Canada

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

IQVIA Biotech collabore exclusivement avec des entreprises de biotechnologie et des sociétés biopharmaceutiques émergentes pour soutenir le développement clinique à toutes les phases et dans tous les domaines thérapeutiques. Notre structure agile, notre culture collaborative et notre expertise thérapeutique approfondie nous permettent d'offrir des solutions sur mesure qui contribuent à accélérer l'accès des patients à des traitements innovants.

IQVIA Biotech est à la recherche d'un(e) gestionnaire d'essais cliniques possédant de l'expérience en oncologie et à l'échelle mondiale.


Les responsables cliniques jouent un rôle essentiel dans la réalisation des essais cliniques. En étroite collaboration avec les équipes cliniques, ils contribuent à améliorer la vie des patients en accélérant la commercialisation de nouveaux médicaments. Membre clé de l'équipe de projet, le gestionnaire clinique est responsable de la réalisation des études cliniques afin de répondre aux exigences contractuelles, conformément aux procédures opérationnelles normalisées (POS), aux politiques et aux pratiques en vigueur. Il assure la réalisation des essais cliniques pour les clients, pilote les équipes cliniques et collabore avec les chefs de projet et les autres équipes fonctionnelles pour garantir le respect des exigences de réalisation à chaque étape.

Fonctions essentielles :

  • Assurer la réalisation des essais cliniques des projets assignés, conformément aux exigences réglementaires (Conférence internationale sur l'harmonisation (ICH) - Bonnes pratiques cliniques (BPC), protocole), aux exigences du client (contrat) et aux exigences internes (politiques, procédures opérationnelles standard (POS), plans de projet).
  • S'assurer que les objectifs de recrutement des projets sont atteints et s'assurer de la mise en place de stratégies de recrutement appropriées.
  • Contribuer à l'élaboration du plan de gestion des risques du projet et gérer les risques cliniques tout au long de son cycle de vie.
  • Assurer la qualité des essais cliniques en identifiant les normes et exigences de qualité, en planifiant les modalités d'évaluation de la conformité et en assurant le suivi et la gestion des problèmes de qualité clinique. • Gérer les aspects cliniques du financement du projet, y compris l'estimation à l'achèvement (EAC). Comprendre la portée de la prestation clinique et élaborer des plans pour sa mise en œuvre. Suivre et gérer les modifications par rapport à l'estimation à l'achèvement (EAC) de référence et identifier les occasions de services supplémentaires ou les travaux hors périmètre.
  • Identifier les intervenants cliniques du projet et gérer les intervenants internes et externes grâce à une communication efficace et une gestion rigoureuse des problèmes.
  • Collaborer avec l'équipe clinique pour atteindre les objectifs fixés. Faire rapport aux intervenants internes et externes conformément aux exigences du projet.
  • Planifier les ressources et les talents de l'équipe clinique. Encadrer l'équipe clinique au niveau du projet afin d'assurer sa réussite grâce à la mise en place de plans opérationnels de haute qualité, à des formations et à des accompagnements adaptés.
  • Animer des réunions d'équipe régulières et communiquer efficacement pour atteindre les objectifs.
  • Contribuer au perfectionnement professionnel en fournissant une rétroaction aux gestionnaires de première ligne de l'équipe clinique sur leur rendement par rapport aux tâches du projet.
  • Participer, s'il y a lieu, à l'élaboration de la stratégie de prestation clinique pour les propositions. Participer à la préparation et aux réunions de soutenance des offres. Élaborer et présenter le plan d'opérations cliniques en partenariat avec le développement des affaires et la direction de projet. • Peut encadrer et former les nouveaux collègues lors de leur intégration.
  • Peut agir à titre de responsable clinique principal(e) aux côtés d'autres responsables cliniques pour la réalisation d'essais cliniques internationaux de grande envergure.
  • Peut participer aux visites de sites, le cas échéant, pour soutenir la réalisation des projets.

Qualifications

  • Baccalauréat en sciences de la santé ou autre discipline scientifique requise.
  • 5 ans d'expérience en recherche/monitoring clinique ou combinaison équivalente de formation et d'expérience requise.
  • Connaissance de base des pratiques et de la terminologie de la gestion de projet requise.
  • Bonne connaissance des exigences réglementaires applicables à la recherche clinique, notamment les Bonnes Pratiques Cliniques (BPC) et les lignes directrices de la Conférence Internationale sur l'Harmonisation (ICH).
  • Solides connaissances des protocoles et des aspects thérapeutiques.
  • Comprendre les aspects financiers des projets.

Clinical Trial Manager II

IQVIA Biotech collaborates exclusively with biotechnology companies and emerging biopharmaceutical companies to support clinical development across all phases and therapeutic areas. Our agile structure, collaborative culture, and deep therapeutic expertise enable us to offer tailored solutions that help accelerate patient access to innovative treatments.

IQVIA Biotech is seeking a Clinical Trial Manager with oncology experience and a global perspective.

Clinical Trial Managers play a vital role in the conduct of clinical trials. Working closely with clinical teams, they contribute to improving patients' lives by accelerating the commercialization of new medicines. As a key member of the project team, the Clinical Trial Manager is responsible for conducting clinical studies to meet contractual requirements, in accordance with Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), policies, and best practices. They ensure the successful execution of clinical trials for clients, lead clinical teams, and collaborate with project managers and other functional teams to guarantee adherence to execution requirements at every stage.


Essential Functions:

  • Ensure the execution of clinical trials for assigned projects, in accordance with regulatory requirements (International Conference on Harmonisation (ICH) - Good Clinical Practice (GCP), protocol), client requirements (contract), and internal requirements (policies, standard operating procedures (SOPs), project plans).
  • Ensure that project recruitment targets are met and implement appropriate recruitment strategies.
  • Contribute to the development of the project risk management plan and manage clinical risks throughout its lifecycle.
  • Ensure the quality of clinical trials by identifying quality standards and requirements, planning compliance assessment methods, and monitoring and managing clinical quality issues.
  • Manage the clinical aspects of project funding, including the Estimate at Completion (EAC). Understand the scope of clinical delivery and develop plans for its implementation. Track and manage changes to the baseline Estimate at Completion (EAC) and identify opportunities for additional services or out-of-scope work.
  • Identify and manage the project's clinical stakeholders, both internal and external, through effective communication and rigorous issue management.

  • Lead regular team meetings and communicate effectively to achieve objectives.
  • Contribute to professional development by providing feedback to the clinical team's frontline managers on their performance against project tasks.
  • Participate, as appropriate, in the development of the clinical delivery strategy for proposals. Participate in the preparation and presentation of proposals. Develop and present the clinical operations plan in partnership with business development and project management.
  • May mentor and train new colleagues during their onboarding.
  • May act as a lead clinical manager alongside other clinical managers for the execution of large-scale international clinical trials.
  • May participate in site visits, as required, to support project execution.

Qualifications

  • 5 years of experience in clinical research/monitoring or an equivalent combination of education and experience required.
  • Basic knowledge of project management practices and terminology required.

We are the leading provider of professional services to the middle market globally, our purpose is to instill confidence in a world of change, empowering our clients and people to realize their full potential. Financial Examiner, Examiner-In-Charge (EIC)

Risk & Regulatory Consulting, LLC

(Regulatory Insurance)

Work from home-any US location

Position Overview

The Financial Examiner, EIC will primarily perform financial examinations and regulatory consulting services for state insurance departments. This position has significant opportunity for advancement as well as personal and professional growth.

Specific Duties and Responsibilities

  • Perform risk focused financial examinations to determine solvency and compliance to statutes on behalf of Risk & Regulatory Consulting LLC insurance clients.
  • Perform reviews of examination work papers and evaluate insurance company operations.
  • Serve as Examiner-In-Charge on examinations of significant size and complexity
  • Ensure the integrity of the regulatory system.
  • Assist with the preparation of reports, exhibits, and other supporting schedules that detail a company's solvency, condition and compliance with laws and regulations, and recommend solutions to questionable financial conditions.
  • Responsible for timely submission of draft reports for review.
  • Recommend/document actions to ensure compliance with laws and regulations, or to protect solvency of the company.
  • Provide knowledge and guidance of insurance laws, rules, and regulations.
  • Review and analyze new, proposed, or revised laws, regulations, policies, and procedures in order to interpret their meaning and determine impact to the company.
  • Analyze financial operating statements, reports, and records relating to specific and overall operations of insurance companies; prepare and supervise writing of clear, complete, concise, and informative reports of financial conditions of insurance companies and health care organizations.
  • Consistently enhance knowledge of: principles, practices, techniques, and methods of accounting and auditing; insurance examination and regulation; insurance laws and Insurance Commissioner's rulings; and related Attorney General opinions and court decisions; insurance company practices; statistical sampling procedures; basic actuarial mathematics; principles and practice of effective supervision, insurance companies and health care organizations.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's Degree in Accounting or Finance; MBA and/or professional certification/s preferred
  • Minimum 10+ years’ experience as a financial examiner serving as EIC on exams of significant size and complexity.
  • Insurance industry experience is a must.
  • Certified Financial Examiner (CFE) is a must, CPA or CPA candidate, and/or Certified Internal Auditor (CIA) or CIA Candidate a plus

  • Strong interpersonal, presentation, analytical and examination/audit skills
  • Excellent organizational skills and the ability to prioritize multiple tasks, projects and assignments using effective time management skills
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills are required
  • Dynamic/flexible demeanor with exceptional client service skills
  • Must be self-motivated, work well independently and possess a sense of urgency
  • Skilled in team building and team development
  • Work from home with flexibility to travel

jobs.description:
When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.

At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.

Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.

Parexel is currently seeking a Senior Clinical Data Analyst to join us in either South Africa, Poland, Hungary, or the UK, dedicated to a single sponsor.

This role will be responsible for performing Data Management activities that support the sponsor’s commercial and development projects worldwide. The successful candidate will participate as an active member of a multi-disciplinary team to plan and execute the Data Management tasks required for phase I – IV studies. The Senior Clinical Data Analyst has a broad, fundamental knowledge of the data management process and can perform most required tasks with minimal guidance.

Working as a Senior Clinical Data Analyst at Parexel FSP offers tremendous long-term job security and prospects. We undertake vital clinical studies for sponsors including the leading global biotechs and Pharma top 50. And we have an incredible pipeline of work.

Expect exciting professional challenges in inspiring studies, but with time for your outside life.

This will be a fully remote home-based position. RAVE experience is strongly preferred.

Responsibilities

  • Lead a large clinical study or a series of related studies with minimum guidance.

  • Represents Data Management on the CTWG for assigned studies.

  • Provide mentoring and training to lower-level Data Management staff assigned to your studies.

  • Manage and monitor the progress of data management activities with CROs or other vendors on assigned studies; build effective relationships with CRO / vendor counterparts.

  • Review protocols for appropriate data capture including electronic Case Report Form (eCRF) design.

  • Be able to perform a thoroughly detailed review of eCRF data requirements.

  • Interact with CRAs, programmers, study managers and statisticians in designing eCRFs and creating the annotated eCRF and CRF completion guidelines.

  • Lead the development of data edit check specifications and data listings.

  • Coordinate the design and testing of Electronic Data Capture (EDC) systems according to company standards. Able to resolve EDC system issues with team members.

  • Develop or lead the development of the Data Management Plan for a clinical study.

  • Able to review and provide feedback to the clinical team on other study documents e.g. Clinical Monitoring plans, Statistical analysis plans and vendor specifications.

  • Provide training on the EDC system and/or eCRF Completion Guidelines at Investigator Meetings and to internal and external study team members as needed.

  • Perform reconciliation of header data from external data sources against the clinical database.

  • Perform Serious Adverse Event reconciliation activities according to SOPs and guidelines.

  • Lead database upgrades/migrations including performing User Acceptance Testing.

  • Maintain study workbooks and data management files.

  • Perform database lock and freeze activities per company SOPs.

  • Participate in regular team meetings and provide input when appropriate.

  • Provide input into the development of data management SOPs, Work Instructions, and process documents; take a leadership role in the development of assigned documents.

  • Contribute to a professional working environment including the application of the sponsor’s Code of Business Conduct and Ethics.

  • Assist with the training of new employees and/or contractors.

Here are a few requirements specific to this advertised role.

  • Bachelor’s Degree required, preferably in the scientific/healthcare field.

  • Proven leadership experience.

  • Good project management skills and a proven ability to multitask.

  • At least five years’ or preferably up to 8 years' experience, in Data Management for the pharmaceutical/biotechnology industry.

  • Understanding of the scope and focus of Phase I – IV clinical studies, and a proven ability to perform some of the core Data Management tasks and interact with vendors.

  • A comprehensive understanding of regulatory guidelines and industry standards (e.g., ICH/FDA guidance, CDISC standards, GCDMP, 21 CFR 11, MedDRA, WHO Drug Dictionaries, etc.) and their application to Data Management practice.

  • Attention to detail and the ability to work individually, within a multi-disciplinary team, as well as with external partners and vendors.

  • Strong English language written and verbal communication skills.

  • Able to travel to meetings or training seminars on occasion.

  • Possesses solid computer system and technical skills with a strong ability to learn multiple computer applications. Prior experience with different Data Management systems and technologies, and Electronic Data Capture systems is desirable.

  • Experience and understanding of the Oncology or CNS therapeutic area and with Phase III pivotal studies are desirable.

We care about our people and your passion, as they are the key to our success, and provide an open and friendly work environment where we empower people and provide them with opportunities to develop their long-term careers. In addition, you will have the opportunity to develop within your role and tackle further responsibilities or develop your skill set within other related departments of Parexel.

Who are Parexel

Parexel supports clinical studies across the full range of therapeutic areas, and we have longstanding partnerships with a vast client base.

We supported the trials of most of today’s top 50 best-selling drugs, but equally we enable more niche drug developments that are critical to the well-being of many patients.

You’ll be an influential member of the wider team.
